articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Algorithm for Multi-UAV Maritime Targets Search Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved route planning algorithm based on genetic algorithm(GA) to solve the route planning problem of multi-UAV maritime targets search, which is similar to the multi-traveling salesman problem. The algorithm proposed in this paper is based on K-means algorithm and GA, and uses the mean-variance model as the optimal route selection operator. It consists of two sub-algorithms of targets classification and path planning. First, through the K-means targets clustering based on GA, the number and length of chromosomes are obtained, and the problem of classification of marine search targets is solved. Then, through the multi-chromosome GA, the optimal path of the maritime targets search path is obtained. The simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the search range of the algorithm, improve the running speed of the algorithm and the global search ability.

articleTitle: DCFGAN: Dynamic Convolutional Fusion Generative Adversarial Network for Text-to-Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Text-to-image synthesis is the task of synthesizing realistic and text-matching images according to given text descriptions. Most text-to-image generative networks consist of two modules: a pre-trained text-image encoder and a text-to-image generative adversarial network. In this paper, we propose a stronger text encoder which employs a text Transformer to extract semantically meaningful parts from text descriptions. With the stronger text encoder, the generator can obtain more meaningful text information to synthesize realistic and text-matching images. In addition, we propose a Dynamic Convolutional text-image Fusion Generative Adversarial Network (DCFGAN) which employs the Dynamic Convolutional Fusion Block to fuse text and image features efficiently. The Dynamic Convolutional Fusion block adjusts the parameters in the convolution layer according to different text descriptions to synthesize text-matching images. It improves the efficiency of fusing text features and image features in generator network. We evaluate the proposed DCF-GAN on two benchmark datasets, the CUB and the Oxford-102. The extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed stronger text encoder and Dynamic Convolutional Fusion Layer can greatly promote the performance of text-to-image synthesis.

articleTitle: An Intuitive and Accurate EMI Model for a Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has numerous sub-modules (SMs) that are complex electromagnetic interference (EMI) sources. It poses a challenge on the EMI analysis of MMC. Motivated by the challenge, this article presents an intuitive and accurate EMI model of MMC based on the superposition theorem. The stray parameters of MMC system are extracted to characterize the high-frequency characteristics of the circuit. By modeling the SMs as individual EMI sources, an EMI equivalent circuit is derived which can intuitively tell the conducted EMI principles of MMC. The EMI model based on the EMI equivalent circuit can accurately predict the EMI results of MMC without a great deal of calculation. Simulation results verify the effectiveness and validity of the proposed EMI model.

articleTitle: Comparison of Trajectory Clustering Methods based on K-means and DBSCAN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to better mine information from the data of automatic identification system (AIS) and scientifically perceive the water traffic situation, several common clustering algorithms, such as K-means algorithm and DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) algorithm, are studied and analyzed, and the advantages and disadvantages of each algorithm and applicable scenarios are compared. Taking the actual ship's AIS trajectory data as an example, each algorithm is used to verify its characteristics, which provides convenience for further information mining of trajectory data.

articleTitle: Device-Free Crowd Counting Based on the Phase Difference of Channel State Information
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Estimating the number of people accurately in an area of interest plays a critical role in various applications. In this paper, we perform crowd counting from 0 to 7 persons with a closed meeting room scenario. Triple processes (linear transformation, the phase difference extraction and Savitzy-Golay filtering) are performed on the CSI raw phase so that we can successfully extract the features related to the human moving, eliminate environment interferences and phase errors effectively. We propose the support vector machine (SVM) model based on the phase difference expanded matrix of channel state information (CSI) between adjacent receiving antennas. The mean and standard deviation of the phase difference series calculated in a time window at each time spot are added into the initial phase difference matrix. The proposed phase difference expansion matrix can improve the accuracy and robustness in the subsequent SVM classification. This model achieves 98.82% counting accuracy with only a maximum of 1-count-difference.

articleTitle: Intelligent Colorization for Thermal Infrared Image Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Thermal infrared image coloring is an important issue to improve human perception in various fields, such as military, medical, security etc. This paper presents a novel algorithm to generate visual, i.e. perceptually realistic color(RGB) images from thermal infrared(TIR) images based on convolutional neural networks(CNN). The proposed approach uses an encoder-decoder architecture with skip connections. In the encoder-decoder framework, the input is passed through a series of layers that progressively downsample, until a bottleneck layer, at which point the process is reversed. There is an enormous low-level information shared between the input and output, and it would be desirable to shuttle this information directly across the net. To circumvent the bottleneck for information, we add the skip connections. We train our model on a KAIST-MS dataset and present illustrative qualitative and quantitative analysis of our results. Experimental results with a large set of original images provided the validity of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Comparison of road traffic accident prediction effects based on SVR and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Road traffic accident prediction is an important topic in traffic research. Taking China's traffic safety status as the research object, according to the non-linear characteristics of China's road traffic accidents, using principal component analysis to reduce the dimensionality of road traffic accident statistics data in China, comparing the two methods of SVR and BP neural network Comparison shows that the estimation accuracy of SVR is better than that of BP neural network, and its prediction accuracy meets the requirements of road traffic accident prediction.

articleTitle: An improved whale optimization algorithm with cultural mechanism for high-dimensional global optimization problems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Whale optimization algorithm (WOA) is a swarm intelligence optimization algorithm which imitates the behavior of humpback whales. It has been widely accepted to solve problems in various engineering fields because its less required parameters and excellent optimal performance. Similarly to other meta-heuristic algorithm, WOA still has the disadvantage of trap in local optima. In this paper a cultural whale optimization algorithm(C-WOA) is proposed to prevent the algorithm from falling into local optimum, which combines cultural algorithm and whale optimization algorithm. The double evolution mechanism is considered in C-WOA for integrating the advantages of different mechanisms of population space and knowledge space, which effectively improves the performance of whale optimization algorithm. The proposed C-WOA is benchmarked on six well-known test functions, and the results show that the algorithm is effective in solving complex high-dimensional problems.

articleTitle: Study on Prediction Method of Flight Fuel Consumption with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to reduce the extra fuel carrying of the flight and improve the fuel efficiency and commercial payload of the fleet, a flight fuel prediction model is put forward based on machine learning method. The flight plan, aeroplane operation data, risk control data of the flight and aeroplane performance data are used to construct the feature vector of flight fuel consumption. The regression relationship between the feature vector and the fuel consumption of the flight is established by using the random forest algorithm. Based on historical flight data, the flight fuel prediction model is trained, and a comparative experiment is designed to verify the validity and fitting ability of the model. The model will be deployed in the near future to help flight dispatchers to make flight plans in X airline.

articleTitle: A Survey of Online Advertising Click-Through Rate Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, online advertising sales have been the main economic sources of Internet companies such as Google, Facebook, Snap, Pinterest, and Baidu. Advertising click-through rate measures the ratio of users who click an advertisement to the total users who view the advertisement. The click-through rate is very important for Internet companies' online advertisements quality. The click-through rate of online advertising is related to many factors, including gender, age, type of advertisement, and the timely and effective prediction of the click-through rate of online advertising as well as advertisement text. In recent years, the click-through rate of online advertising has become one of the hot areas of research in industry and academia. Advertising prediction models are generally divided into two categories: shallow learning models and deep learning models. This paper surveys Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction models, discusses the problems in the current advertising click rate prediction models, and points out future research trends.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Active Defense for Distribution Internet of Things Service Security
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, through the construction of an active defense system for the service security of the power distribution Internet of Things, the corresponding single-point defense capability and cooperative defense mechanism are formed for different attack scenarios of “cloud, management, edge and end”, so as to effectively improve the defense capability of the power distribution Internet of Things against various complex attacks and illegal operations and change passive defense into active defense.

articleTitle: Social network-based News Recommendation with Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: News recommendations aimed at alleviating network information overload. Traditional methods cannot simultaneously consider the representation of entities in the news at the level of knowledge and the influence of social networks on user interest points. The above two factors have a huge correlation with the efficiency of news recommendation. In order to consider these factors, this paper proposes a news recommendation model based on knowledge graph and social network which integrates knowledge graph representation and social networks into news recommendations. The model is a deep recommendation framework based on content and social networks for click-through rate prediction. The model utilizes the knowledge graph for representing entities in the news, quantifies the impact of social networks, and capture the dynamic changes of user interest. It adopts an improved sampling mechanism to quantify the social network structure. It uses a random walk sampling strategy to obtain neighbors in the social network. Moreover, it obtains the neighbor's influence weight on the target from interaction and content. The attention mechanism is used to quantify the effects of browsing records on user interests to capture dynamic changes. Experiments show that our model can effectively improve the effectiveness of news recommendations.

articleTitle: Research on Secondary Analysis Method of Synchronous Satellite Monitoring Data of Power Grid Wildfire
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the process of monitoring the power grid wildfire, synchronous satellite may produce false fire point information. By using the hot spot monitoring data of Himawari-8 synchronous satellite and field verification information during 2015-2020, this study constructs a secondary analysis algorithm of hot spot monitoring data based on binary decision tree, and analyzes the effectiveness of the algorithm in the improvement of fire identification. The research shows that the algorithm of hot spot secondary analysis has advantages in adapting to data characteristics, fast automatic identification, and autonomous optimization. After training and testing the monitoring data of 2015-2020 hot spots data, the binary decision tree algorithm can significantly reduce the hot spots monitoring error rate of synchronous satellite, with a 100% accuracy rate of the true fire and a 77.1% accuracy rate of the false fire. There is a certain difference between North and South of monitoring fire data of synchronous satellite. As a whole, the accuracy of North fire is higher, and the more south the lower accuracy is.

articleTitle: An Iterative Extended kalman filter algorithm applying Doppler and bearing measurements for underwater passive target tracking
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on bearing and Doppler frequency measurements, this paper presents a new method of state estimation for passive underwater target applying Extended Kaman filter (EKF). By linearizing the measurement equation through Jacobian, the state of passive underwater target is estimated with iterative algorithm. The Monte-Carlo simulation results show that the method can efficiently improve the accuracy of state estimation for passive underwater target. The performance of proposed algorithm for state estimation is better than that with bearing only observation applying EKF algorithm. Presented approach and obtained results may be useful in underwater passive target tracking and command decision-making application.

articleTitle: Prediction of Gas Concentration Based on PSO Optimized GRU Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The prediction of underground gas emission is the key to underground gas accident prevention. Aiming at the problem of coal mine gas emission prediction, a time series-based prediction model of gas emission from coal mining faces is proposed. Use particle swarm optimization (PSO) to optimize parameters and use GRU model to predict. Three indicators, absolute mean error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error(RMSE), and running time, are used to evaluate forecasting performance. The prediction results are compared with BPNN and GRU neural networks. The results show that: PSO-GRU model has higher prediction accuracy and prediction stability.

articleTitle: Metal Foreign Object Detection in Electric Vehicle Wireless Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Wireless power transfer technology has developed rapidly as a novel technology for its safe operation, flexibility, convenience and low maintenance cost. The electric vehicle wireless power transfer system transmit energy relying on high-frequency electromagnetic field. However, it may cause the hidden danger of temperature rise and fire, and even affect the parameters of the coupling structure, leading to the deviation of the working point, if any metal foreign objects accidentally entering the energy transmission area. In view of the above problem, the metal foreign object detection technology of electric vehicle wireless charging system was systematically discussed in this paper. The influence of metal foreign matter entering the magnetic coupling mechanism was analyzed. Then the technical route of foreign object detection at home and abroad was summarized. This paper also focused on the analysis of the detection method based on the characteristic parameters of the detection coil. Finally, the technical challenges including coil offset and points picking were discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Conducted EMI for Sub-Modules in Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) is stacked by numerous sub-modules (SMs) which contain many stray capacitances. As a result, the analysis of conducted electromagnetic interference (EMI) is very complicated. In this paper, the SMs in the symmetrical position of the upper and lower bridge arms are regarded as a group, And a conducted EMI model is developed to elaborate the common mode (CM) interference mechanism of each group. Then the CM current components of each group are separated by sweep frequency analysis and source extraction methods. The results are consistent with the theoretical analysis. Accordingly, proper strategies are given to reduce EMI according to the role of different SM group. Finally, the simulation results tested from a MMC grid-connected inverter system are conducted to confirm the validity of the analysis.

articleTitle: Model Analysis of Unmanned Bicycle and ADRC Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Bicycle is a typical nonlinear and unstable system, and its mechanical properties and stability have been extensively studied. Aiming at the self-balancing problem in the driving process of the driverless bicycle, the bicycle structure and its motion characteristics are analyzed, and the bicycle dynamics model is established based on the theorem of the moment of momentum of the particle system and its stability is analyzed. Using the ADRC(ADRC: Active Disturbance Rejection Control) control method, real-time estimation of system input and output status information and internal and external disturbances are made through the extended state observer, and then the nonlinear error feedback controller is used to compensate the estimated disturbances in real time, and the designed controller is stabilized Proof of sex. The simulation results show that the designed controller can better track the target speed and effectively realize the attitude control of the unmanned bicycle.

articleTitle: Research on Reverberation Cancellation Algorithm Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Reverberation is an important interference factor that affects the active sonar detection effect generated by the sonar emission signal. Since the reverberation and the transmitted signal have almost the same frequency spectrum, suppressing this interference factor is the current research difficulty in the field of underwater acoustic target detection and position recognition. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a reverberation cancellation algorithm based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD). The design and verification ideas of the algorithm are as follows: First, the space-time-normal wave model is simulated and modeled. Secondly, the empirical modal decomposition of the echo data and the reverberation data is conducted. The difference between the various modes to obtain the characteristic information of the target signal. Finally, the experimental data verifies the effectiveness of the EMD reverberation cancellation algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research and advances in vegetation management for power line corridor monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the green vegetation monitoring situation in the transmission line corridor, this paper expounds two problems, one is the risk management problem in the transmission line corridor, and the other is the analysis and practical test of vegetation monitoring technology. In this paper, the method of detecting vegetation in the corridor of transmission line by aerial photography and image recognition is proposed. The vegetation information in complex background can be extracted and identified by means of template comparison and graph segmentation. According to the field test, the method proposed in this paper has achieved good results, and there is a high accuracy in high-speed detection. The detection method can be applied to the transmission line monitoring using helicopter and drone.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Active Defense System Oriented to Electric Power Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The safety control and production management of the electric power system are highly dependent on network communication between all levels. The security problems of the network always threaten the stable operation of the power grid. Combined with the analysis of the network security demands of the electric power monitoring system, an active defense system framework design is proposed, and a complete set of defense methods is given from the aspects of the host, the security and the network equipment. The system adopts multi-layer architecture and functional modular design. It integrates modules such as data collection, threat analysis and identification, active defense, active defense strategy library, and public service. The structure of each functional module is independent of each other, which facilitates independent deployment or unit testing.

articleTitle: City urban rail transit train-ground wireless communication network research based on LTE technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Briefly introduce the existing problems at the urban rail transmit train-ground wireless communication based on WLAN and analyze the LTE technical characteristics. Propose the urban rail transmit train-ground wireless communication networking scheme based on LTE technology, include network architecture, frequency range selection and bandwidth design. Verify the network performance and syn bearing capacity of this networking scheme through develop the field actually test.

articleTitle: A Detect method for deepfake video based on full face recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous upgrading of computer hardware and the continuous development of deep learning technology, new multimedia tampering tools can make it easier for people to tamper with faces in videos. Tampered videos produced by these new tools may hardly be detected by human, so we need effective method to detect these face-tampered videos. Current popular video face tampering technologies mainly include Deepfake technology based on self-encoder and Face2face technology based on computer graphics. In this paper, we propose a new method for tamper video detection based on the full faces. Facenet algorithm is used here to compare the similarity between real and fake video faces. Finally, in the experimental part, the results showed a significant effect.

articleTitle: A SPI Interface Module Verification Method Based on UVM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The serial peripheral interface (SPI) is an important module for realizing communication between the APB bus in the SOC chip and peripheral SPI devices. Therefore, efficient and sufficient verification of the function of the SPI module is very important for the design and manufacture of the SOC chip. In this article, a verification environment for SPI module is built based on universal verification methodology (UVM). By introducing the register abstraction layer (RAL), the efficiency of register attribute checking and configuration is greatly improved. In addition, the use of constrained random excitation and automatic result comparison function has realized the full verification of the SPI function, with a coverage rate of 100%. Finally, the verification environment of the SPI module has been successfully migrated to the SOC verification environment.

articleTitle: Research on Driver's Gaze Zone Estimation Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the increasing importance of gaze tracking technology in the detection of driver's attention and fatigue, the estimation of the driver's gaze zone has become a key point and a hot issue for safe driving. Although there has been significant improvement in the research of the driver's gaze area at present, a general gaze zone estimation system for different subjects and perspectives is still lacking. In order to better accomplish this task, this paper uses the “Columbia Gaze Data Set” that contains 56 subjects with different gaze directions and head poses to estimate the driver's gaze zone. After pre-processing the pictures such as normalization and data augmentation, the image dataset is modeled and predicted using the improved VGG16 convolutional neural network structure constructed by Keras, and the 5 head poses and 21 gaze points of each head pose in the dataset are reclassified and divided into 8 gaze areas, corresponding to the gaze zone of the driver.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Edge Collaboration Architecture in Power IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of network resource redundancy and overload caused by the widespread use of chimney-type independent service access in the current power IoT architecture, this paper proposes a model of cloud edge collaborative architecture applied to the power IoT. In this mode, edge computing devices or networks are set up around the perception layer devices of the power IoT to process massive power / non-power data locally. This model combines the centralized nature of cloud computing and the decentralized nature of edge computing to meet the requirements of big data computing and real-time analysis of local data, and fits the complex network and data access and management requirements of the power IoT.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Home Intelligent Water Quality Inspection Device
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Water pollution has become the primary problem of environmental pollution in China and some countries in the world. Water quality detection is an important method to solve the problem of water quality, which can be used as a powerful guarantee for sewage treatment, improvement of technology, protection of the original ecology of water and provision of scientific basis. In this paper, a home intelligent water quality detection device is developed, which is mainly used in the home, mainly through the detection of turbidity to judge the water quality, so as to scientifically identify which water can be used for secondary use, so as to save drinking water. With the help of the sensor to collect the signal of the target object, the obtained signal is converted through ADC into the single-chip microcomputer, processed by the single-chip microcomputer, and displayed by the display module, so as to further analyze the water quality situation reliably. This system mainly includes the design of hardware circuit and system program. The hardware circuit mainly includes sensor circuit, single chip microcomputer small system, A/D conversion circuit and display part design. The software design mainly deals with the signal processing and the display of the collected information. Finally, we make the real object to achieve the design effect.

articleTitle: A Driving Fatigue Dataset of Driver's Facial Features and Heart Rate Features
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of single eigenvalue type and not-real fatigue evaluation in the current published driving fatigue dataset, and conforming to the research development trend of facial and heart rate features fusion, this paper studies a set of simulated fatigue driving experiment scheme using low intrusive camera and smart watch as fatigue information collection equipment, and combined with self-evaluation and expert-evaluation of fatigue state. According to this experiment, a fatigue driving dataset including driver's facial features, heart rate features and more realistic fatigue evaluation is obtained. Facial features are five categories of 51 dimensions, including head posture, gaze direction, facial micro expression, eye opening and mouth opening. Heart rate features include 7 dimensions such as instantaneous-HR, mean-HR, SDNN, RMSSD, LFP, HFP and LFP/HFP. The dataset is composed of 2400 sample data of 20 experimenters, and the training set and test set are randomly divided into 7:3, which can be used for the training and test of the corresponding driving fatigue detection model.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of sensor information fusion system based on cloud theory and fuzzy pattern recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The sensor information fusion system was composed of complex factors, and there was no unified quantitative standard for each factor. During the system evaluation, the existing evaluation method cannot be applied to all influencing factors, and the result of the evaluation cannot represent the true performance of the system. This paper proposed an evaluation method combining cloud theory and fuzzy pattern recognition model. Based on the cloud theory, the reasonable conversion of qualitative indicators was realized, and the uncertainty of attribute factors was evaluated indefinitely. Combined with the fuzzy pattern recognition model, an evaluation model was established for quantitative indicators, and it was comprehensively processed by fuzzy evaluation method. Evaluation examples show that the method can more accurately and objectively evaluate the performance of the system.

articleTitle: Application-oriented Model Management Method on Dispatching and Control Cloud
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the construction of the dispatching and control cloud platform, more and more dispatching applications need to rely on the model data of the cloud for function realization. The dispatching and control cloud uses the methods of unified modeling and integrated model maintenance to construct cloud models with unique coding, unique properties and unique parameters. In view of the differences between the storage form of the dispatching and control cloud model and the model form required for the dispatching applications, this paper proposes an application-oriented model management method on dispatching and control cloud, which can help the applications to define the model structure on demand, subscribe the cloud model data, save the historical model versions required for the application, and make cloud model support the dispatching applications.

articleTitle: Research on Security Protection Technology of Terminal Access Network Based on Fingerprint Perception and Identity Protection of IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper proposes a kind of security protection measures such as vulnerability detection and identity authorization management for the equipment and transmission network segments based on the existing terminal access network field equipment and transmission network segments by using fingerprint sensing technology and identity protection technology, combined with advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data processing and Internet of Things technology. It will further enhance the safety and reliability of Internet of Things equipment, provide equipment managers with the basis for formulating accurate safety management plans, and provide effective guarantee for the safety of existing terminal access network equipment.

articleTitle: Graph Homomorphisms Based On Particular Total Colorings of Graphs and Graphic Lattices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Lattice-based cryptography is not only for thwarting future quantum computers, and is also the basis of Fully Homomorphic Encryption. Motivated from the advantage of graph homomorphisms we combine graph homomorphisms with graph total colorings together for designing new types of graph homomorphisms: totally-colored graph homomorphisms, graphic-lattice homomorphisms from sets to sets, every-zero graphic group homomorphisms from sets to sets. Our graph-homomorphism lattices are made up by graph homomorphisms. These new homomorphisms induce some problems of graph theory, for example, Number String Decomposition and Graph Homomorphism Problem.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Reinforcement Learning in the Board Game
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning is one of the core technologies, which leads to artificial intelligence. It has been used widely not only in robot, autonomous driving, power station control and human-computer interaction in mobile e-commerce platforms, but also in gambling games. The game software AlphaGo of artificial intelligence defeated Ke Jie in 2017. Since then, the study of artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement is widely concerned. We build a Neural Network model using TensorFlow and Monte Carlo tree search algorithm, so that agents can reach the level of playing chess with human beings in board games. The gobang interface is realized by Python, and the PhoenixGo recurrence is completed. The computation is reduced and the training effect of the agent is improved by optimizing the establishment of gobang strategic value network. Black hand first can achieve a 73% winning rate, and white hand first is 64%, when playing against human players.

articleTitle: Recognition and Locating of Damaged Poles in Distribution Network Through Images Shot by Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UA V)
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The disaster recognition and locating are important for the rush repairment after disaster happened. And there have been some advanced facilities applied for the image collecting, such as unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). To accelerate the image processing, the intelligent recognition and automatic location solution are both considered instead of the manual way. Firstly, the model based on yolov5 is construed to realize the recognition of damaged poles in distribution network, marked by a rectangle box. Then, the coordinate transformation is adopted to derive the positions of damaged poles in real world with the inputs of coordinates in images and the necessary information extracted from images. With the locations of damaged poles collected, the fast disaster locating can be realized. At last, the practical images are chosen to testify the performance of intelligent recognition and location solution.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Random Forest Algorithm Based on Classification and Regression Tree
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Decision tree is a popular method for various machine learning tasks. Tree learning structure can best meet the requirements of data mining. The current applications of decision tree usually aims for a specific case, In addition, the number of features extracted from these decision trees is relatively low, usually less than 10. Although this reduces the use of resources and time, it is also easy to reduce the accuracy of the algorithm. This paper mainly studies the method of building decision tree based on CART algorithm and the hardware design and implementation of the random forest algorithm. In this paper, a random forest algorithm is introduced to solve the problem of over fitting, the SystemC language is used to model the random forest algorithm, including the training part and the inference part of the algorithm, when the input data exceeds the bank depth, it can be stored 2-4 times by cutting the bank address bit in half, and constructed a system model of the data storage method, the design completes the hardware implementation of the random forest algorithm, the training part includes the data storage module, the top-level control module, and the algorithm execution module, the inference part includes the data storage module and the top-level control module. Finally, the functional correctness of the hardware implementation is verified on FPGA. The decision tree data storage scheme proposed in this paper has high practical value, and improves storage efficiency through bank folding.

articleTitle: Implementation of The High-Speed SM4 Cryptographic Algorithm Based On Random Pseudo Rounds
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The SM4 cryptographic algorithm is one of the standards of commercial cryptographic algorithm in China, which is used widely in the data encryption and other application scenarios for the advantages of less resources and fast speed. The attackers attack the first and last round of SM4 algorithm generally in the side channel attack. The number of the invalid random rounds before and after the SM4 cryptographic algorithm can make the side channel information collected by the attacker invalid in order to resist the side channel attack; At the same time, the multistage pipelining method is adopted to realize the SM4 cryptographic algorithm at the high speed, that is, four rounds of operations are realized every cycle, and one SM4 grouping operation is completed in eight cycles. The implementation results of the FPGA show that the clock frequency of SM4 cipher operation is up to 100MHz and the throughput rate under ECB mode is up to 1.6gbps, which has the advantages of high performance and anti-side channel attack.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Platform Direction Finding Cross Location Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the electronic reconnaissance system, the position of the radiation source and its carrier platform is estimated by measuring the parameters of the radiation source, which is called passive location. It does not emit electromagnetic signals, has a long operating range, good concealment, and has strong survivability and anti-stealth capabilities. Compared with traditional radar, it has the characteristics of low cost and environmental friendliness. Directional cross location uses multiple reconnaissance stations at different locations to determine the location of a radiation source based on the measured direction of the same radiation source. In general, the azimuth angle changes slowly, which is one of the reliable radiation source parameters. Especially in the complex electromagnetic environment, the azimuth parameter is particularly important. When using azimuth angle for location, the time uniformity between the platforms is relatively low, so it is of great significance to study the method of direction finding and location. On the basis of describing the principle of direction-finding cross-location, this paper mainly determines the influence of various measurement parameters on location accuracy in the location system through theoretical analysis and simulation, and provides a certain reference for engineering practice.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Attention Networks for Grid Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development and popularization of power Internet of Things (IoT), IoT produces a large number of distributed data, the electronic text data and the concurrency of multiple services. To support unified management of all data on an existing basis and make the system has the ability to accurate and efficient data analysis, many researchers have devoted efforts to studying an effective algorithms for solving the problem of the electronic text retrieval, information extraction, and classification in the power grid system. However, the accuracy of these algorithms is not satisfactory. In our paper, we will use an effective deep learning model to classify the grid text. i.e., the hierarchical attention networks model. In particular, Attention mechanism is a commonly model with long-term memory mechanism in the field of NLP, which can intuitively evaluate the contribution of each word to the result in a text. Experimental results show that the Hierarchical Attention Networks model obtains the highest accuracy than the existing methods.

articleTitle: The research on fingerprint recognition algorithm fused with deep learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, through deep learning, preprocessing and neural network training, the similarity of the fingerprint orientation field is finally given, which has reached the final fingerprint matching. First, calculate the direction field information of the fingerprint through a mathematical model; secondly, preprocess the collected fingerprint data, and remove the fingerprint data with the center point at the edge of the fingerprint image and the fingerprint data without the center point to find suitable data for training Set, the input of the next layer in the neural network is the splicing of the input information and output information of each layer in the neural network to achieve a tight connection between each neural network layer; through continuous training, a clear fingerprint recognition effect is finally achieved. Experiments show that the method proposed in this paper has a higher recognition rate.

articleTitle: Univesal Design of LLC Resonant Converter with Fixed Switching Frequency
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a universal design for the LLC resonant converter with fixed switching frequency is proposed. In order to realize zero voltage switching (ZVS) and zero current switching (ZCS), the fixed switching frequency is selected slightly lower than the resonant frequency. Subsequently, the simplified model of LLC resonant converter is derived based on the fundamental harmonic approximation (FHA) method, and the relationship among voltage gain, the inductance ratio λ and the quality factor \pmbQ in frequency domain is analyzed. Based on this, a universal design of resonance tank parameters is given, and a simulation model is built in Saber. Finally, the simulation results well verify the effectiveness of the design method.

articleTitle: Trajectory planning of 7-DOF redundant manipulator based on ROS platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the complex model construction and single function of the traditional robot simulation platform facing specific objects, the open-source robot operating system(ROS) is adopted to carry out the trajectory planning. Firstly, we establish the 7-DOF manipulator model in the Solidworks and get a simplified model with the sw2urdf plugin. Then, on the ROS platform, the Moveit setup assistant makes it easy to configure the manipulator for motion planning. Finally, We accomplish the motion planning in Rviz based on OMPL which consists of many sampling-based motion planning algorithms. Random sampling algorithm (RRT) is selected to combine Moveit and Gazebo for 7-DOF manipulator. The results show that it can provide a more intuitive method to further improve and research on the trajectory planning of the manipulator.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Second-generation ID Card Number Identification Model based on TensorFlow
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a model base on tensorflow framework in Python language to complete the identification of ID card number. Firstly, the image of ID card is preprocessed by a computer vision library (OpenCV), including angle correction, grayscale and binarization and so on. Secondly, an algorithm is used to project the image, and obvious projection peak area is number area, meanwhile the number area of ID card is determined, character segmentation is carried out by using the fixed width height ratio and spacing of characters. And then the data set is trained by the convolutional neural network. Finally, the character segmentation is recognized and the ID card number is output. In the end, the model is tested to show that the training speed is fast, the recognition and identification accuracy is high, and the convolutional neural network(CNN) has a certain value.

articleTitle: Binarized Neural Network Based On FPGA To Realize Handwritten Digit Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: We trained a binarized neural network (BNN) which can be used for handwritten digit recognition on software, and implemented this BNN on the FPGA using software training parameters without the help of high-level synthesis (HLS). This BNN contains an input layer, two convolutional layers, two pooling layers, a fully connected layer and an output layer. The first convolution layer contains 10 convolution kernels, each of which has a size of 5 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> 5. Each convolution kernel uses 25 arithmetic units to calculate in parallel, the calculation of 10 convolution kernels is also parallel. The size of the convolution kernels in the second convolutional layer is 38 * 3, the input and output channels are 10, we use 900 XNOR gates for calculation here. Compared with the traditional CNN, it does not need to consume DSP resources and requires less storage space for the parameters. And the power consumption obtained by Quartus ii software of this BNN is 0.136 W. The time to identify a picture is 18 μs, and the accuracy rate is 85% without the batch normalize (BN) layer.

articleTitle: SMOTE-based Category Imbalance for Radar Radiation Source Sorting and Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The aim of this study is to realize the problem of sorting and identifying radar radiation sources with category imbalance. In this paper, a method based on the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) is presented. In the study, the SMOTE technique is applied to generate a larger number of minority samples in the data sets. In the study, the SMOTE technique is applied to generate a larger number of minority samples in the database In the study, the SMOTE technique is applied to generate a larger number of minority samples in the data sets, so that the number of majority and minority categories are gradually balanced, and then the parameters of the radar radiation source signal (direction of arrival (DOA), pulse width (PW), pulse repetition frequency (PRF), and radar frequency (RF)) are selected as characteristics for classification, using decision trees, random forest, and XGboost three supervised learning algorithms are used to classify the rebalanced data sets. The experimental results show that the STOME algorithm excels in category-imbalanced radar source sorting identification, improving the problem of low accuracy caused by the presence of a few class samples in traditional methods.

articleTitle: Scheduling of multiple mobile robots based on time windows and improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the low efficiency and easy to fall into local optimum in the current path planning research, an improved ant colony algorithm is proposed. In the ant colony algorithm, the difference between the previous generation best path and the current iteration best path has dynamic change information, which improves the efficiency of the algorithm by feeding forward the pheromone generated by the dynamic change information; Aiming at the path conflict problem of mobile robot, a multi robot cooperative obstacle avoidance strategy based on time window algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the calculation method of multi robot conflict area is studied. Secondly, the time window arrangement method of two or more paths crossing is given, which realizes the efficient cooperation of multi robot in the workshop.

articleTitle: The Description of Optimal Decision Tree Algorithm and Its Application in Customer Consumption Behavior
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper describes the basic idea and main disadvantages of decision tree algorithm, proposes to add optimization parameters to the information gain algorithm, and weighted important attributes, so that the small number of data tuples will not be ignored in the generation of decision tree, and at the same time, reduce the rule results of decision tree by optimizing pruning, and form more valuable decision information. This algorithm model is applied in the analysis of customers' consumption habits, which improves the accuracy of classification results and prediction information, and provides more targeted decision support for enterprises to make sales strategies.

articleTitle: I-Vector and DNN Hybrid Method for Short Utterance Speaker Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The paper proposes a hybrid model method of I-Vector and DNN to enhance the recognition accuracy of the short utterance speaker recognition system. Firstly, In order to improve the recognition accuracy of I-Vector model, this paper adopts the probability linear discriminant analysis method to avoid channel interference in speech. As a critical method, the DNN makes it possible to extract deep features by training speech features in deep neural networks, which has achieve the effective training and recognition with a small amount of speech data. Finally, a dual discrimination mechanism based on the hybrid model is proposed to effectively overcome the shortcomings of small training samples and easy interference, thus improving the recognition rate of short speech speaker recognition system. The speaker recognition experiment based on TIMIT database indicate that the presented method can effectively improve identification accuracy of the speaker recognition system in short utterance environment.

articleTitle: Research on Testability Allocation Method based on AHP-Entropy Weight Combination
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Testability allocation is a process of assigning system-level testability indexes to units according to certain rules. Aiming at the disadvantage that the traditional testability allocation method based on AHP is subject to experts, which may bring irrationality of the allocation outcomes, a testability allocation method based on the combination of AHP and entropy weight method is proposed to reduce and avoid the error because of subjective factors. A certain ship inverter is used as an example to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed allocation method.

articleTitle: Application of Convolutional Neural Network in Handwritten Chinese Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The handwritten Chinese character data set HWDB, designs and trains a convolutional neural network to recognize handwritten Chinese characters. On this basis, this article tested and studied the effects of activation function, loss function, and learning rate on the performance of convolutional neural networks, and further analyzed the reasons for their effects, and accumulated for the subsequent application of convolutional neural networks in other aspects. The valuable experimental experience and theoretical basis were laid. This paper is based on the relevant technical process, analyzed the experimental effect, summarized the influence of important parameters, and summarized the design ideas of neural network for different image types, laying a foundation for further research in the future.

articleTitle: Extremal Region Analysis based Deep Learning Framework for Defects Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A maximal stable extremely region (MSER) analysis based convolutional neural networks (CNN) for unified detects detection framework is proposed in this paper. Our proposed framework utilizes the generality and stability of MSER to generate the desired defects candidates. Then a specific trained binary CNN classifier is adopted over the defects candidates and produces the final determined defects. Experiments on various defects dataset over different categories have demonstrated the effectiveness of our proposed framework. Beside, we can adjust the parameter settings in MSER to satisfy different requests over various industries (high precision, high recall, etc).

articleTitle: Research on Control System of Electro-Magnetic Suspension Maglev Train
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The electro-magnetic suspension system of the maglev train is considered as the wheels, which plays a major role in bearing the weight of vehicle. The paper is concerned chiefly with the study of control system of electro-magnetic suspension system. The mathematical model of electro-magnetic suspension system is established and the control strategy is designed. In order to verify and investigate the control performance of the electro-magnetic suspension system, three working circumstances are performed to test. The simulation results have revealed that the control performance of the electromagnetic suspension system under three load circumstances is qualified.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Modeling of LLC Resonant Converters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Owing to the advantages of high efficiency and high power density, LLC resonant converters have been widely used. Generally, in order to design the closed-loop regulator, the small-signal model is necessary. Nevertheless, the small-signal model of LLC resonant converter is usually complex and inconvenient to be used to design regulators. In this paper, a third-order small-signal model of LLC resonant converter is derived, which is simple enough to obtain analytical expressions and conducive to be utilized to design the closed-up regulator. Finally, the accuracy of the model is confirmed by the simulation results.

articleTitle: A Parasitic Mechanism-Based Filter Pruning Method for Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The convolutional neural network (CNN) shows excellent performances in various applications at the cost of huge storage and calculation overheads. To compress and accelerate the CNN, conventional methods usually prune the unimportant filters under the pre-selected standards, which should be artificially and carefully designed according to the specific application scenarios. In this paper, we propose a general CNN accelerating and compressing method, i.e., the parasitic mechanism (PAM)-based filter pruning algorithm. First, the parasitic layer is constructed on the basis of the convolutional structure and the gate module. Then, the parasitic layers are attached to the original CNN, which carry out the pruning process for the filters in each layer. The above attaching and pruning process is named as the parasitic mechanism. Compared with the traditional filter pruning methods which pre-select the pruning standards artificially, the PAM method intelligently learns the pruning standard in the training process, and prunes the unimportant filters under the constraint of maintaining the performance of the original CNN. As verified by simulations, the proposed PAM algorithm has a better pruning performance than the conventional filter pruning methods.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of ZVS PSFB converter controlled by average current mode
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The ZVS PSFB converter controlled by average current mode has the advantages of fast response and strong anti-interference ability, but its structure of control system is complex and the PI regulator is difficult to design. In this paper, the transfer function of the average current mode control system was derived with the small signal model of ZVS PSFB converter, the PI regulator was designed with assignment of zero and pole of transfer function by Bode diagram, the system simulation model was built with combination of component module and phase shift control phase shift control program in Matlab/Simulink environment, and the validity of the design scheme was verified.

articleTitle: Closed-loop Stability Analysis of DC / DC Converter with Input Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a buck-boost converter is used as the satellite power controller. In order to realize the MPPT loop's sampling the converter input current in buck mode, an LC input filter is added to the converter input. Taking a prototype with a rated power of 500W as an example, the dynamic modeling of the buck-boost converter and the design of the compensation network parameters are first performed, and based on Middle Brook's Extra Element Theorem, a comparative analysis of the influence of the addition of the undamped input filter and Rf-Lb parallel damped input filter to the closed-loop converter on the stability is conducted. The analysis shows that the introduction of Rf-Lb parallel damped input filter can not only achieve the filtering effect on the input current of the converter in buck mode, but also the Rf-Lb damping circuit can well suppress and absorb the resonance energy.

articleTitle: A Non-Cooperative Power Control Game Algorithm Based on Fairness
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of wireless terminal access demand, the spectrum resources are becoming more and more scarce. However, the spectrum utilization is at a low level, using cognitive radio (CR) to improve spectrum utilization is considered to be a good solution. Power control is widely used in spectrum sharing of cognitive radio, which is one of the key technologies of cognitive radio. This paper aims to improve the fairness of the system on the premise of guaranteeing the quality of service (QoS) of primary users (PUs) and secondary users (SUs). Based on the non-cooperative game model with pricing function, a new power control algorithm based on fairness is proposed. The pricing function is improved so that the algorithm can consider the channel conditions of different users. In this paper, it is proved that the algorithm converges to a unique point and exists a Nash equilibrium solution. Through numerical simulation, it is proved that the algorithm can effectively reduce the transmission power by sacrificing part of signal to interference plus noise (SINR) under the premise of ensuring QoS, and the algorithm has good fairness.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis Method of Trip Risk under the Condition of Large Scale Icing of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Icing trip of transmission line in winter is a serious power grid disaster. This study focuses on 110-220kV transmission lines, builds the basic trip prediction and analysis model from the theory of icing growth, and makes effective optimization and modification of the model in full combination with the empirical parameters formed in the actual work. In terms of physical model, the ice weight of transmission line is defined as the key factor of line icing trip under the assumption of uniform icing growth, and the characteristics of daily weight increase of icing are emphatically considered. The calculation formula of daily risk index of icing trip is formed. In the aspect of empirical correction, considering the non-linear characteristics of the change of trip risk due to the increase of ice thickness under the actual situation, combined with the ice melting and deicing factors as the key control indicators of model prediction results, the empirical factor correction is carried out for the icing trip prediction model. The validity of the model is compared with the historical data.

articleTitle: Research on OPC UA Security Encryption Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of the internet, the existing risk coefficient in it is also rising. The original defense system has been unable to effectively resist the current risk. Illegal network monitoring, network intrusion attack, theft, tampering, network terrorism and other illegal criminal activities are flooding the whole network space in different degrees, which may bring security threats and economic losses to enterprises and individuals at any time. And with the development of industrial informatization, the data in the process of industrial production needs to be shared or users can see the production data at any time, so the security of data in the transmission process becomes a problem. At present, the OPC UA protocol is used by the devices in the factory when they interact with each other. This paper mainly studies the security status and communication efficiency of OPC UA. The communication efficiency here is mainly the encryption efficiency of the encryption algorithm, which improves the communication efficiency by improving the encryption efficiency.

articleTitle: Pedestrain Detection in Infrared Images with Improved YOLOv2 Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the progress of unmanned driving technology and the attention of security problems, pedestrian detection is getting more and more researchers' participation. Since 2012, the application of deep convolutional network has greatly improved the accuracy and detection speed of pedestrian detection. However, it is difficult to detect pedestrians at night, the detection accuracy of small objects and obstructed pedestrians is poor, which are problems that researchers are solving. This paper presents infrared image detection of pedestrain based on improved YOLOv2 detection network. It improves the detection accuracy of small volume and blocked pedestrian in the night.

articleTitle: Study on Temperature Fault-tolerant Control of CSTR
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Safe production occupies a very important position in chemical production, and chemical reactors are one of the most dangerous equipment in the chemical process. For the characteristics of the continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) with coil and jacket cooling system, a temperature dual-control scheme of CSTR based on the analysis of CSTR exothermic reaction control characteristic was proposed for an organic material polymerization production. Based on the analysis of the thermal stability of CSTR and the establishment of a mathematical model, the design and realization of the fault tolerance of the coil cooling failure and the jacket cooling failure. The control solution has passive fault-tolerant ability for the jacket cooling water cutting off fault and active fault-tolerant potential for the coil cooling water cutting off fault, and it has good control ability, high saving energy and reducing consumption performance. Taking advantage of the strong correlation between the reaction temperature and reaction pressure of CSTR produced by polymerization, an active fault-tolerant control of CSTR temperature sensor failure based on pressure safety control is designed. With semi-physical simulation, the control system designed for CSTR temperature control is proven valid.

articleTitle: Dual Path Nets with A New Multi-scale Backbone Architecture For Pulmonary Nodule Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article mainly completed the detection of lung nodules using deep neural network and built a complete end-to-end detection system. U-net structure has significant advantages in image segmentation. We propose a dual-path network with a U-shaped structure that combines the advantages of residual learning and intensive learning for the detection of lung nodules. And on this basis, the residual module of Resnet was modified. The feature image fed into the residual module is divided into multiple blocks for convolution. Smaller residual blocks are added to each part to broaden the receptive field of each layer. So, it has the ability of extracting multi-scale feature. This network structure is called Res2net. The processed feature images are fused. We also added the SE module to focus on the relationship between feature information channels. It can strengthen the role of useful channels and suppress the output of useless channels. These changes significantly improve the detection effect of lung nodules. We used the position regression of lung nodules to return the predicted position of lung nodules and achieved good results. The detection indicator FROC is significantly better than other detection projects.

articleTitle: An adaptive fusion panoramic image mosaic algorithm based on circular LBP feature and HSV color system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the sharp edge of stitching line, object splitting, uneven color fusion and obvious stitching traces in the process of panoramic image stitching, a new panoramic image stitching algorithm is proposed. Before stitching, the adaptive image color fusion based on HSV color system is carried out, the local texture features of the image are described by circular LBP Operator, and the energy accumulation distribution table is obtained by using the optimized pruning dynamic planning algorithm. Finally, the image fusion is carried out in the overlapping area by interlacing backtracking and optimizing Gaussian filtering wave. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional stitching algorithm, the image quality level is improved, the color is too uniform, and there is no obvious hum in stitching.

articleTitle: Research on user energy storage optimization system considering a grid-on new energy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the proportion of new energy in the power grid continues to increase, it brings many challenges to the optimal dispatch of traditional distribution networks. The optimal dispatch strategy of the active distribution network is a key technology that needs to be improved, and the optimization of user energy storage is of great significance. The optimal dispatch strategy of the active distribution network includes many aspects such as source, load, and storage. This paper only considers the optimal charging and discharging strategy of the user's energy storage equipment after the new energy is connected and builds the user's energy storage system cost model, user revenue model, new energy electric field revenue model after energy storage equipment is connected, and energy storage equipment charging and discharging model. The results show that the energy storage optimization proposed in this paper can ensure the interests of the power supply side, the user side, and the power sales company, and is more conducive to mobilizing the three parties to participate in the user load response and energy storage equipment access under time-of-use electricity prices.

articleTitle: Study on the Performance of the Variable Step-Size LMS Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, the authors discussed the existing variable step-size adaptive filter algorithms firstly, and then classified and analyzed the performance of two typical variable step-size LMS algorithms. Based on which, the authors proposed shortcomings that are not mentioned in the conventional variable step-size LMS algorithm. At last, we provide the simulation results, which proved the correctness of the previous analysis.

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Power Prediction Model Based on GSA Optimized GRU Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The short-term prediction of wind power has an important role in the safe and stable operation of the power system. In order to achieve high-precision short-term wind power prediction, a short-term wind power prediction model based on the Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA) optimized Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural network is proposed. First, a GRU neural network is established, which uses a gated recurrent unit. Compared with the traditional recurrent neural network using traditional recurrent units, it overcomes the problems of gradient explosion and gradient disappearance that may occur in the traditional recurrent neural network; Then, the improved gravitation algorithm with strong global optimization ability is used to optimize the GRU neural network parameters, which effectively improves the prediction accuracy of the model. Through actual simulation analysis and comparison with traditional GRU neural network prediction model, LSTM neural network prediction model and Elman neural network prediction model, the proposed short-term prediction model of wind power has good accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Research on consensus algorithm of multi energy interaction agents based on PBFT
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The flexible flow of renewable energy in multi energy system is an important means to make full use of renewable energy. However, the realization of multi energy system collaborative optimization faces many obstacles at the technical and institutional level. The authenticity of multi energy data, the distributed decision-making of complex system, and the trust between interaction subjects make it impossible for all interaction subjects to reach an effective consensus. As a decentralized and intelligent emerging technology, blockchain has great technical compatibility with the energy Internet, which can provide effective solutions for the collaborative optimization of the energy Internet and realize the profound transformation of the energy Internet. This paper compares and analyzes common consensus mechanisms in blockchain, and proposes a consensus method based on Practical Byzantine fault tolerance (PBFT). In this paper, we use Java programming to simulate a blockchain network composed of four nodes. The experimental results show that the consensus method can ensure the effective consensus between the multi energy interaction agents in the case of node downtime.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetizing Inrush Current and Fault Identification of Transformer Based on VMD-SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of misoperation of transformer differential protection that is susceptible to inrush current in the past, this paper proposes an identification method of excitation inrush current based on variational mode decomposition-support vector machine (VMD-SVM). The MATLAB/simulink software platform is used to build a transformer excitation inrush current and fault current model, and the difference current signal is decomposed using VMD to obtain signals of different scales. Based on permutation entropy, feature extraction is performed on the signal to obtain permutation entropy of different waveforms, and the characteristics of permutation entropy are used as input parameters of SVM for classification. Experimental results show that the scheme can accurately identify the transformer magnetizing inrush current and fault current, and the recognition accuracy is high, which provides a reference for identifying the transformer inrush current and fault.

articleTitle: Single Image Dehazing via Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Single image dehazing aims at restoring the clean image from single hazy one. A novel Reinforcement Learning (RL) based image dehazing method is proposed in this paper to handle the dehazing task with interpretable ability and extensibility. We model the dehazing problem as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) with several existing simple traditional image processing operations and prior knowledge-based dehazing methods as actions. Furthermore, a deep Q-learning network is established to learn the value function for image dehazing. Finally the learned network can iteratively choose the correct action during the processing sequence to produce dehazing results. Extensive results on real hazy images have been conducted to verify the proposed method. Also the learned sequence of image dehazing can provide considerable guidance for human.

articleTitle: Multi-radar Signal Level Fusion Detection Algorithm based on Fast Time Accumulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of multi-radar joint detection, the performance of non-coherent accumulation detection algorithm under fast time sampling is analyzed. In order to improve the detection performance, two fast time phase-coherent accumulation detection algorithms are designed based on Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test (GLRT): 1. Fusion detection algorithm based on rapid phase-coherent accumulation in a single station;2. Detection algorithm based on overall signal fusion. From the perspective of theory and simulation, the performance of the two improved methods for detecting low-speed or stationary targets is better than that of the non-coherent accumulation detection method. Method 1 is suitable for distributed networking, while method 2 is suitable for centralized networking. The improved algorithm can extract target Doppler features while fusion detection, and provide information for target recognition and motion analysis.

articleTitle: A Review of ISAR Imaging Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the requirements of radar resolution improving, the aperture of traditional radar has become the bottleneck of its development. In order to overcome this problem, phased array radar and virtual aperture radar are proposed.
