Virtual Aperture Radar can be divided into Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR). The ISAR has the advantages of all-day, all-weather, long-distance, and high resolution, and is widely used in military and civil fields. This paper first briefly introduces the principle of ISAR imaging, the concepts of range resolution and azimuth resolution, then introduces the common methods of envelope alignment and self-focusing, and finally analyzes several ISAR imaging methods, such as large angle imaging algorithm, compressed sensing imaging algorithm, and micromotion target imaging algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and application of Power Consumers Behavior Based on K-means
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on the data of power users in a certain city, this paper adopts K-means clustering algorithm to realize the clustering analysis of power users' monthly load data. According to the cluster of electricity users, the electricity users are roughly divided into different types, such as citizens, merchants, enterprises and factories. A measure standard is introduced to evaluate the reliability of the algorithm. Based on the clustering results of the monthly load curves of power users, it can be found out that the characteristics of power users in the corresponding month. According to these characteristics, this paper can play a guiding role in formulating the corresponding power service strategy for different types of power consumers in power supply companies.

articleTitle: A dual power bus transceiver with multi-voltage
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper introduces a dual power bus transceiver structure with multi-voltage to solve the data exchange problem between low-voltage FPGA core devices and high-voltage peripheral control circuits. Its design idea is based on the multi-voltage I/O buffer, and some important control circuits are used to change its working state to ensure that the circuit works normally under different level standards. The difficulty of the design is how to use 3.3V devices to make the input/output reach 5V which is higher than the device voltage, so it is necessary to design a suitable withstand voltage control module. Finally, design of the transceiver was implemented in a fully customized chip. After experimental testing, it is found that its function is correct, and the transmission speed, main delay parameters, and driving ability have good results.

articleTitle: Improved BP Neural Network to Predict the Comprehensive Performance of Concrete
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the feasibility and accuracy of the concrete comprehensive performance prediction model, the factor analysis method and the BP neural network method are combined to propose an improved BP neural network concrete comprehensive performance prediction model. Example data was selected to test the improved BP neural network concrete comprehensive performance prediction model. The test results: the relative average errors of the 28d strength and slump expansion of the 14 groups of training sample predicted values and actual values were 3.398% and 1.712%, respectively. The average relative errors of 28d strength and slump expansion of each predicted sample are 4.33%, 3.80%, 5.77%, 2.07%, 1.02% and 3.55%, 0.94%, 1.48%, 0.59%, 2.00%, all of which are less than 10%, Which proves that the improved BP neural network prediction model has better prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the opportunity network routing and forwarding strategy based on the social attributes of nodes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, the study of routing algorithm in the opportunity network has found that the different properties of nodes may lead to different functions of node forwarding, so it has become an important research problem to choose the appropriate node attribute for data forwarding. In view of this problem, a routing and forwarding strategy based on the social attributes of nodes is proposed. When selecting the forwarding node, the message is forwarded to the appropriate node by using the familiarity between the compute nodes, the social centerness of the node, and the social similarity of the nodes as the basis for the forwarding. When the buffer space of node is full, the message is deleted with the lowest value. The simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce the delay of forwarding messages and improve the efficiency of message delivery.

articleTitle: Analysis of Decentralized Energy Transactions Based on Smart Contract
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The recent burgeon of decentralized techniques has highlighted peer-to-peer transactions. And the high degree of trading freedom and efficiency in peer-to-peer transactions has facilitated the implementation to allocate energy in power systems. During attempts to apply blockchain in energy trading, researchers found Smart Contract, an essential function of blockchain, beneficial to the energy trading efficiency, besides the ability of keeping trading data tamper-resistant. To analyze the feasibility, validity and advantages of methods to accomplish decentralized energy transactions based on Smart Contract, we presented a basic model to illustrate the principle of how to use Smart Contract in energy trading at first. Then, we summarized three typical methods with diverse characteristics, including Independent Negotiation, Pre-distributing Strategy, and Smart Contract Processing. Besides, we designed one trading example based on the Pre-distributing Strategy, with the application scenario of Virtual Power Plant in power systems. The trading result showed that proper adaptions of the method can satisfy some requirements such as reducing the pollution emission.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Remote Control Service Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This design is a wireless remote control service robot based on Embedded Linux, which is divided into two parts: the upper computer and the lower computer. The upper computer is the remote control terminal of the robot, and ARM Cortex-A9 processor is used as the control core. The lower computer is the executive end of the robot, and STM32 MCU is used as the main controller. Through Lora wireless remote control, the upper computer can realize mobile walking, obstacle avoidance, voice broadcast, human-computer interaction, manipulator grasping and other service functions. This design can be applied to cleaning, medical, tour guide, education, security and other service robot fields.

articleTitle: Research on Battery Management System Based on Active Balance Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper designs a battery management system for the isolated DC/DC balance circuit, studies the active balance architecture based on the multi-winding flyback circuit, builds a MATLAB simulation model for balance simulation, and uses LTC6804 and LTC3300 to design prototype of a battery management system. Tests show that the sampling accuracy of battery cell voltage can reach 2mV, the balance current can reach 2A, and the management system can effectively perform balance control.

articleTitle: Prediction of Resumed Production Trajectories in the Post-Epidemic Area Based on Big Power Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Before the Spring Festival of 2020, China began to spread the new 2019-ncov coronavirus, and the outbreak period coincides with the Spring Festival. The ability to resume production of post-epidemic after the festival has become the focus of attention. This paper proposes an improved forecasting method for resumption based on big data and trajectory clustering. This method clusters the daily power consumption patterns of different industries, summarizes the characteristics of the epidemic situation, and improves the intelligent prediction method. It can evaluate the resumption of production in regional industries and enterprises when there is no clear trend in the external economic environment. It quantitatively solves the problem of forecasting and evaluating the degree of resumption in the context of the epidemic. Calculations are made for the resumption of production in typical industrial agglomeration areas, and the results show that the method can accurately reflect the recovery trend of enterprises and industries from the perspective of feature modification.

articleTitle: Research on powertrain matching and control strategy of extended-range hybrid electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Range extender as the key power source of extended-range hybrid electric vehicle, the working mode of the extender determines the working mode of the hybrid. Based on the principle of using electric energy to drive as much as possible and reducing the start-stop times and working time of the range extender, an optimal control algorithm for shortening the working time of the range extender is proposed, and the simulation analysis is carried out based on the couple-simulation platform of MATLAB/Simulink and GT-POWER. The results show that the control algorithm can reduce the working time of the range extender, and reduce the energy loss during charging and discharging. Thus, the fuel consumption and emissions of the range extender are reduced.

articleTitle: A Method of Extracting Road Network Structure from Trajectory Data Based on U-Net Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Accurate road network plays a very important role in urban traffic application. The traditional methods to generate road network are expensive and the update of the road network is not timely enough. With the widespread use of Global Positioning System (GPS) embedded equipment, lots of moving objects can generate a large amount of trajectory data, from which it could become possible to extract road network information. The existing road network extraction methods require different prior experiences and parameters for road networks in different regions, and the effect is not satisfactory. In this article, we propose a method to generate city road network structure based on an improved U-Net network, which can extract road network from trajectory data. More specifically, we first learn the existing road network structure and extract the feature from trajectory data, then use the improved U-Net network to infer the road centerline, finally, we postprocess its topology and generate the final road network. Our method has been validated on different trajectory datasets and achieved good visualization results.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Press-Assembly Quality Based on Grey Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: It is very important to predict press-assembly quality by analyzing the massive quality data collected during high-precision servo mechanism assembly. Based on the relationship between the press-assembly force and quality of the high-precision servo mechanism, a method of predicting the press-assembly quality based on gray Markov model is proposed in this paper, and the press-assembly dataset of high-precision servo mechanism assembly is dealt with. Firstly, the system cloud gray prediction SCGM(1,1)c model is established for initial prediction; then, the Markov chain model is applied to upgrade the initial fitting accuracy to improve the prediction accuracy; after that, the prediction effects of gray model, system cloud gray model and gray Markov model are compared and analyzed through experiments. Experiments show that the gray Markov model has higher prediction accuracy and stability; finally, the outlier detection method of press-assembly force is studied to find out the control boundary value and define the control range of press-assembly force. The press-assembly quality prediction based on the grey Markov model provides a new method for that of the high-precision servo mechanism.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Downlink MIMO NOMA Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For a vehicular network, non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) allows multiple users to be served in the same time frequency block. In this letter, we consider a wireless downlink vehicular multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) NO-MA network consisting a base station, a cental user and a cell-edge user. Employing maximum ratio-combing technique, we obtain the function of achievable rates. In order to get the the theoretical outage performance, we studied the Wishart matrices to express the achievable rates. We obtain both the exact results of outage probability and the asymptotic results of outage probability. Numerical results show that our exact results match the simulation results.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Classification of Travel Value of Passengers between Wuhan and Yichang based on Large Samples
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Through the evaluation and classification of the travel behavior characteristics of different groups of passengers, it is of great significance for railway transportation enterprises to formulate different marketing strategies and products. Based on the idea of Big Data, this paper takes all the passengers of between Wuhan and Yichang who taking high-speed train as the research samples, uses the fuzzy clustering (FCM) and artificial neural network (ANN) algorithm to calculate and evaluate the price sensitivity of all the passengers, and divides all the passengers into six categories according to the potential economic value and price sensitivity of each passenger. According to the final value of six groups of passengers, make targeted marketing strategies, provide personalized products, and realize the basic concept of Revenue Management. Finally, in the peak period and the low period of passenger flow, sort six groups of passengers according to the travel value of passengers.

articleTitle: Research on yaw crossing point optimization based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper proposes a yaw trajectory replanning method based on improved genetic algorithm, which improves the population quality by changing the confirmation method of crossover operator and mutation operator; by constructing fitness function and using the new constraints to search for new guidance Point method to achieve yaw track replanning of civil aircraft. Comparing the results obtained by the two, the improved genetic algorithm can effectively avoid the air threat zone while satisfying the Improve the efficiency of the solution. Finally, the simulation on the Matlab platform shows that the improved genetic algorithm accelerates the convergence speed, can plan a high-precision trajectory in a short time, and has good real-time performance. This method has good practicality in the civil aviation industry.

articleTitle: On Modular-$2q$ Graphic Groups Of Topological Coding For Graphic Passwords
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Since encrypting networks wholly by graphic groups, we will define a new labelling, called modular- 2q mixed odd-graceful labelling, and build up various graphic groups based on the modular- 2q mixed odd-graceful labelling. We will show: the necessity and sufficiency of subgroup of a graphic group; a ( p, q) -graph G admitting a modular- 2q mixed(negative) odd-graceful labelling can generate a graphic group, and moreover these graphs form an Abelian additive graphic group. A ( p, q) -graph G admits a modular- 2q odd-graceful labelling f generate 2q vertex-modular graphs, each of them generates 2q edge-modular graphs, which form an Abelian additive graphic group, similar results can be obtained for modular- 2q negative odd-graceful graph and modular- 2q mixed odd-graceful graph.

articleTitle: Drug Resistance Prediction of Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is one of the common lung cancers and mainly treated clinically through EGFR-TKI. As time goes on, NSCLC patients are prone to develop resistance to the drug. The resistance may be different types, which increases the difficulties of clinical treatment. In order to capture the biological characteristics of tumor at different timepoints, we analyzed the serial medical images of NSCLC patients, and proposed a neural network using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent neural networks (RNN), to predict the type of drug resistance in NSCLC patients. The CNN is used to extract the features of tumor images at different timepoints, the RNN will then analyze these features and take the time domain into account. A total of 168 NSCLC patients are split 3:1 into training cohort and test cohort, which are used to train and evaluate the model. In the end, the model achieved 79.16% accuracy on the test set. The results show that the method has obtain preliminary effect in the prediction of drug resistance in NSCLC patients.

articleTitle: Study on Security Protection Technology of Multi-Network Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the wide application of information technology, the network architecture presents heterogeneous characteristic. As different security requirements, how to realize connection and security management of heterogeneous networks has become an inevitable challenge. Accordingly, it is important to study information security technology in the situation of multi-network integration. Based on the technologies of security supervision, physical dependence and network virtualization, this paper discusses the methods of security protection for multi-network integration. Furthermore, strict management regulations are established to improve the multi-network security performance. The above-mentioned methods were expounded and have been applied to a certain multi-network structure. The result indicates that the security protection scheme presented in this paper is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Application of Large Strain Fiber Grating Sensing Technology in Aircraft Structural Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aircraft structural strain monitoring is the core of aircraft single life control. It has important economic and military significance to accurately record the fatigue damage degree of the key and dangerous parts of each aircraft structure, accurately predict the remaining life of aircraft structure, and realize state-based aircraft maintenance. This paper around the optical fiber sensing technology is applied in aircraft structure monitoring is studied, through the distribution of optical fiber sensors according to certain forms in key, dangerous parts of the structure, laying structure strain monitoring, record the degree of fatigue damage, developed a set of aircraft structure fatigue critical parts based on the technology of optical fiber sensing strain monitoring system. The key technologies of equipment miniaturization, signal demodulation and precision realization are mainly solved. The system has prominent advantages of light weight, small volume, corrosion resistance, electromagnetic interference resistance and wide measurement range.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Method On Wind Power Absorption Capacity Of Regional Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to evaluate the maximum available wind power capacity more accurately, a comprehensive evaluation method based on peak load regulation capability, static security and transient stability is proposed. With the help of stochastic production simulation technology, the wind power capacity absorbed by the power grid under the constraint of traditional peak load regulation capacity is modified, the combined capacity of each wind power access point is globally optimized by enumeration method, and the transient stability of the system is verified by setting large disturbance conditions, and finally the maximum wind power capacity that can be absorbed by the regional power grid is obtained.

articleTitle: 3D Convolutional Neural Network for Gait Recognition And Demographic Factor Prediction Based on Plantar Pressure Images
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper proposed a new gait recognition method based on 3D convolutional neural network(3D-CNN). The plantar pressure image is a continuous time series, and the current method has not been fully utilized the spatiotemporal information. By normalization and image stacking, the original pressure data is encoded into spatiotemporal feature vectors to implement classification recognition and regression prediction. We tested our algorithm on the CAD WALK Healthy Controls dataset which has 55 subjects and each subject has 24 walking images. The experiment results turn out that our 3D-CNN network can get high classification accuracy and demographic factors such as height, weight, age and shoe size can also be predicted better as compared to many other methods.

articleTitle: Research on Damping Power Oscillation Control Strategy of Distributed Static Synchronous Series Compensator
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Distributed static synchronous series compensator (DSSC) is a kind of distributed flexible AC transmission systems (D-FACTS) that can be distributed installed on transmission lines. This paper analyzes the control principle of DSSC and establishes a DSSC dynamic mathematical model. To suppress the power oscillation of power system, this paper deduces the relation between the variation of generator angular velocity and the variation of DSSC pulse width modulation coefficient in a single-machine infinite system, establishes the transfer function of the control system and adopts the DSSC to improve the system power damping, reducing the power oscillation. The simulation model is built in the PSCAD/EMTDC, and the results show that the damped power control strategy of DSSC device can effectively suppress the power oscillation of the system.

articleTitle: A method of Radiation Source Identification based on DST-IFS
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the current complex electromagnetic environment, radiation informations obtained by different sensorsare different, resulting in different identification confidence levels. Based on the abundant analyses on evidence weight measurement on information confidence, this paper applies the original evidence of decision-making to assign values to intuitionistic fuzzy membership and nonmembership under the DS framework, and then makes decision based on intuitionistic fuzzy decision -making methods, and proposes a radiation source identification method based on a combination of DS evidence theory and intuitionistic fuzzy set (Dempster-Shafer evidence theory-intuitionistic fuzzy set, DST-IFS). Experiments show that this algorithm can meet the actual requirements on confidence difference of information obtained by multiple sensors under complex electromagnetic environment, and improve the accuracy rate of radiation source identification results.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Maintenance Training for Airborne Electronic Equipments
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Maintenance training of airborne electronic equipments is a prerequisite for ensuring the normal operation of airborne electronic equipments. Using real electronic equipments for maintenance training is a choice, but the result is expensive electronic equipment and increased training costs, and may damage normal electronic equipment. In order to reduce the training cost and training risk of electronic equipment maintenance, a virtual maintenance training system for airborne electronic equipment is designed using virtual reality technology. The system uses 3DMax to develop the three-dimensional model of the equipment, uses GLStudio to simulate the various operation responses of the equipment, and uses the multi-signal model to realize the fault simulation of the equipment, and the maintenance scene is realized by VegaPrime. The actual training effect shows that the virtual maintenance training system can be used for daily maintenance training of aircraft and has higher training benefits.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Music Virtual Community Based on Expectation Confirmation Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The huge commercial value brought by the development of the music virtual community has attracted widespread attention. This study takes expectation confirmation theory and music virtual community activity as an entry point, and analyzes the impact of different factors on music virtual community activity. The study used SPSS and Amos software to statistically analyze the collected data and found that Expected Confirmation has a positive effect on Satisfaction; Perceived Usefulness has a positive effect on Expected Confirmation; Perceived Usefulness has a positive effect on Perceived Service Quality; Satisfaction is an important factor influencing Activity; Perceived Service Quality has a positive impact on the User Experience of the community. Therefore, in the management of music virtual community, we must pay attention to the management of community user expectations and improve satisfaction; pay attention to user needs and improve the perceived usefulness of community members; seek a differentiated route to improve the perceived service quality Suggestions.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization Strategy for Multi-period Planning and Scheduling with Data-driven Yield Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The planning and scheduling of production determine the economic benefits of enterprise greatly. In this paper, an integration strategy of multi-period collaborative optimization for production planning and scheduling based on data-driven yield model is proposed. Both expert knowledge and historical production data are used to build the yield model of unit. Considering the purchase plan of raw material, inventory of current raw material, sales price of product and equipment production, the multi-period planning and scheduling collaborative optimization strategy (MPSCOS) is established dynamically. The plan and industry production scheme of raw material processing can quickly be obtained by MPSCOS, which helps gain maximum benefit under the condition of safe production. The application effect of MPSCOS is introduced by a practical case. It shows that the model based on dynamic production process can effectively improve the maintainability; the yield model based on data-driven is more accurate than the traditional yield model, as well as the model updating is convenient; the collaborative model of planning and scheduling can effectively connect the planning with scheduling, and further improve the business efficiency of enterprises.

articleTitle: Sea-Surface Floating Small Target Detection Based on SVM and Multidimensional Features
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Under the influence of sea clutter, the traditional detection methods based on incoherent integration are not ideal for detection of small floating targets. To solve this problem, a sea-surface small target detection algorithm based on joint features and support vector machines (SVM) is proposed. On the basis of analyzing the measured data of IPIX radar, six features-relative average amplitude (RAA), relative Doppler peak height (RPH), relative Doppler vector entropy (RVE), time-frequency ridge energy (RI), number of time-frequency connected regions (NR) and maximal size of time-frequency connected regions (MS) can be effectively extracted from radar echoes. Aiming at combining these characteristics and distinguishing target from clutter in feature space, a virtual alarm adjustable SVM classifier is designed to realize small target detection in sea clutter background. Experiments show that the proposed method can effectively detect small floating targets under low signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Study on Vibration Monitoring of Railway Seamless Line
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale of high-speed rail network in China, in order to improve the speed, train load and safety performance, seamless rail technology is widely used in Chinese lines. And seamless rail is to weld 25 meters long rail into several hundred meters long or even thousands of meters long. Because highspeed rail cannot freely expand and contract, the rail is affected by temperature stress, vibration stress, at the same time high speed starting and braking of high speed railway, Large volume of transport is easy to make the rail fatigue and fracture. In order to ensure the safety of people's life and property, in this study, a new real-time monitoring method for rail condition is proposed., using the rail vibration signal analysis of rail damage, through acceleration sensor to collect the rail. vibration signal, then reduce the interference through kalman filter, get the rail close to the real vibration amplitude. under laboratory conditions, build vibration signal test system, use bench drill hammer rail model, use MPU6050 acceleration sensor to collect vibration signal of rail model, pass STM32F103CBT6 to computer keil program, and import the result into MATLAB for filtering and amplitude analysis. The experiment shows that the acceleration sensor is effective in monitoring the amplitude of rail.

articleTitle: A High-precision FMCW Lidar Ranging System Based on Dual-path Error Compensation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of laser nonlinearity and system environment interference that bring errors to high-precision distance measurement, a composite fiber dual-path Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave(FMCW) laser heterodyne high-precision ranging compensation system is proposed. The measurement mathematical model of the dual-path heterodyne detection system has been established, and the sources of the errors between the nonlinear term and the beat signal was deduced, and the feasibility of the method and the measurement were analyzed through simulation. We also analyzed the feasibility, accuracy of this method by simulation and the average error of the distance measurement is obtained by repeated experiments at different distances. The ranging simulation experiment was carried out within 100 meters and get the experimental results showed that the ranging system based on the FMCW dual-path compensation method the relative error of ranging was 0.2%, within 30m can be less than 0.1%.

articleTitle: The containment of fake news propagation in online social networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Fake news has permeated into people's daily life especially with the help of the popularity of online social networks. Hence containment of fake news propagation becomes a vital issue for modern society. While previous research of fake news containment mainly focused on game theory and information diffusion models on the single network, little attention was paid to the containment on the realistic fake news propagation networks as well as multi-networks. Our finding concentrates on realistic propagation networks and tests the effect of re-posting silence and volume control quantitatively. Furthermore, for the multi-network, the containment of these two methods of fake news is also effective.

articleTitle: Optimized Design for the 12-Pulse Uncontrolled Rectifier With a Coupling Interphase Reactor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Owing to simplicity, lower total harmonic distortion, and higher power factor benefits, the 12-pulse uncontrolled rectifiers with a coupling interphase reactor are widely used as the power factor correction (PFC) converters, which are inserted between the power grid and the non-linear loads. However, the key parameters of the 12-pulse rectifier, such as transformer ratio, coupling coefficient and self-inductance of interphase reactor, and the capacitance of filter capacitor, are generally designed by trial and error, which is complicated and inefficient. In order to offer a useful reference for engineers to design the 12-pulse rectifier, a simply design program is proposed considering current ripple and output voltage ripple. Subsequently, optimized parameters of the 12-pulse rectifier are obtained after running the design program. Therefore, the rectifier can work in high performance with smaller size. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed design program are validated by simulation results.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method for Hybrid Information System Based on Weight Assignment Murphy's Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Single diagnosis method used for fault diagnosis has the characteristics of low accuracy and strong subjectivity. In order to improve the above disadvantages, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for hybrid information system based on weight assignment Murphy's method and builds data fusion diagnosis framework. Firstly, according to the attributes of fault information, the similarity reasoning method and the rule automatic matching method are respectively used in quantitative information and qualitative information for preliminary reasoning. Then the characteristics of probability data of different methods are analyzed and the corresponding weights are given. Finally, the probability data of the two systems are integrated by using the weight assignment Murphy's method to obtain the results. The experimental results show that the method of fault diagnosis using Murphy's method with weight distribution can effectively improve the accuracy and credibility of the diagnosis results.

articleTitle: Design of the dual redundant Controller in the Cabin Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The cabin monitoring system is used to monitor the occurrence of dangerous events in special places and deal with them quickly. The core controller is designed with double redundancy of tight coupling and hot backup. Each independent redundant module is composed of a controller and a redundant control circuit, which has high reliability and availability. The cabin monitoring system has been actually used in the safety monitoring of ships in high-risk places, with high reliability and rapid response ability to ensure that the system can reliably complete the safety monitoring tasks. According to the test, under the specific fault mode, the switching success rate of the dual redundant controllers in the cabin monitoring system is 100%, and the switching time is less than 2s.

articleTitle: Control System Design for Guided Rocket Base on Adaptive Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the model uncertainty of the initial flight stage and the existence of external interference, a sliding mode control system based on feedback-linearization is proposed to solve the problem of attitude control in the initial flight stage of Guided Rocket. Firstly, the motion quaternion of Guided Rocket is established. Secondly, the feedback-linearization method is used to decouple the nonlinear system, and a nonlinear robust controller is designed by combining the idea of bounded disturbance with sliding mode control. Then, the disturbance boundary function and controller parameters are designed to realize the attitude stabilization control of the initial stage of air defense rocket. Finally, the stability of the system is proved through lyapunov theory. The result indicates that the control system based on feedback linearization method and sliding mode technique could ensure attitude stabilization of Guided Rocket and robust when great change of aerodynamic parameters and external interference exists.

articleTitle: An algorithm for edge-magic total labeling of composite graphs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: If the labeling values of edges and vertexs for a graph G(p, q) are mapped to {1, 2,, p+q}, and the sum of the labels of any two vertexs and their associated edges is equal to a constant, this labeling is called edge-magic total labeling. In this paper, a recursive algorithm is designed to obtain the edge-magic total labeling of the finite vertex composite graph. Through the analysis of the results, It is found that the composite graph F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>→ Cl↑ S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> is an EMTL graph, and then some theorems are summarized and proved.

articleTitle: The Control System Design of Concrete Mixing Station based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, with the large-scale development of infrastructure construction, the concrete mixing station was constantly updated and iterated. At present, there are three common control modes of concrete mixing station: relay control, PLC control and single chip microcomputer control. The mixing station controlled by PLC has reliable performance and high cost performance, which can ensure the quality of concrete and improve the production efficiency of concrete. In this paper, the control process of concrete mixing station is studied. The design content includes the process of the system and the control mode of the mixing station, the design of the overall structure, the selection of hardware and software programming. GX developer and Kingview software are used to control and monitor the process of conveying, weighing, mixing and discharging of concrete mixing station. The design of the concrete mixing plant can realize automatic operation, error alarm, and real-time monitoring and other functions. Experiments show that the system has the characteristics of strong reliability and easy operation, and meets the requirements of the design.

articleTitle: Recognition algorithm of handwritten symbol based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: It has become a trend for computers to automatically mark examination papers. This paper presents an algorithm for automatically correcting blank filling questions. We first use edge detection algorithm to find the location of the answer, and cut the storage. Then, the connected domain is used to cut out the characters in the answer and store them as MAT files. Finally, we send these characters to the improved lenet-5 convolutional neural network for recognition. Experiments show that the algorithm can correctly review the blank questions.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Data Acquisition and Supervisory System for Electromechanical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To solve the “Isolated Data Island” problem of the detector in a certain Kaibang-Motor production workshop, a data acquisition and supervisory system based on SQL2014 database was designed, which realizes the automatic collection and recording of the test data, real-time monitoring of the production progress, data statistics, historical data query and other functions. First, build a local area network to provide the data transmission environment. Then process the acquired data based on SQL2014 database to obtain specified format data and statistical results, and upload them to the central database. Finally, two options for using Kingview software and ASP.NET platform to develop data display and query interfaces are introduced. The production practice shows that the system can display the production information, feedback and locate the problems in the production in time, and improve the production efficiency.

articleTitle: Intelligent Maintenance Decision System for High Speed Loader Executing Agencies Based on FT A and FEMCA
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Executing mechanism is the core system of highspeed loader, its performance directly affects the efficiency of high-speed loader. Based on the logical relationship between the failure of various parts and components and the system of the high-speed loader execution mechanism, this paper draws a fault tree, which visually represents the transmission path of each possible failure. Through FMECA method, the harmfulness of each bottom failure is analyzed qualitatively and quantitatively, and an intelligent maintenance decision system based on inference machine and knowledge base is designed for the execution mechanism of the high-speed loader. The decision-making of diagnosis and maintenance of obstacles provides basis and means.

articleTitle: Parallel Intelligent Satellite Based on Digital Quadruplets
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the complexity of satellite platforms and systems, the ACP parallel system theory is applied to the field of satellites. The concept and basic framework of parallel satellites are proposed to define the digital quadruplets of parallel satellites: physical satellites, description satellites, prediction satellites, and guidance satellites. Establish a parallel satellite from a physical satellite to a descriptive intelligence of a descriptive satellite, a predictive intelligence from a descriptive satellite to a prediction satellite, and a guidance intelligence framework system from a prediction satellite to a guidance satellite. Based on this framework system, the parallel control concept of parallel satellites is proposed to the leap from traditional digital satellite to intelligent.

articleTitle: Real-time tracking of visual objects based on deep feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve SiamFC's recognition and localization capabilities in complex scenes, this paper proposes a visual object tracking network structure based on deep feature fusion. Aiming at the recognition ability, the feature extraction network IVBRNet with deep structure is designed based on VGGNet and ResNet, and the deep features with rich semantic information extracted by IVBRNet are used to assist object recognition. For the positioning ability, the ECA attention module is added at the end of the original AlexNet object feature extraction branch and the original Relu activation function is replaced with the ELU activation function to improve the expression ability of the object feature. Finally, the response graphs obtained by AlexNet and IVBRNet are calculated and fused to perform object tracking together. The results on the OTB2015 and VOT2016 data sets show that the algorithm has a more stable tracking effect than other algorithms, and can better cope with scenes such as fast moving and complex backgrounds. At the same time, the algorithm reaches 32 frames per second, which meets real-time requirements.

articleTitle: The Real Time Motion Pattern Recognition of Lower Limb Based on sEMG signals
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this work, we proposed a Back-propagation neural network (BPNN) method based on surface electromyo-graphy(sEMG) signals for recognition of movement in human locomotion. The method only needs six sEMG signals to help detect hemiplegia patient walking. We use experiment first verify the availability of the sEMG data acquisition system. Then quantify the system with a gold standard optoelectronic system Vicon-nexus (VN). The Hip and Knee Joint Angles has a good correlation coefficient and mean squared error of volunteers locomotion. In contrast to the existing methods, the proposed model not only avoids the complex sensor system but also ensures the accuracy of recognition. Meanwhile, the aim of this paper is to build the regression model which relates the multichannel sEMG signals to human lower limb joint angles in order to develop a more natural study for the patients.

articleTitle: Airborne Software Testing Technology Analysis Based on Fault Injection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper introduces fault injection technology. This paper discusses the application of software fault injection technology to the testing of airborne aviation software with high security application requirements. The characteristics, classification and application of software fault injection technology are analyzed. This paper focuses on middle-ware based fault injection technology and its application in high security airborne software testing. System level middle-ware fault injection method and module level middle-ware fault injection method are proposed.

articleTitle: Structure design of transmission type multilayer optical fiber hydrogen sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article uses an optical fiber hydrogen sensor based on the light-emphasis system. It has a transmissive optical structure, and multiple sensor films can be placed to measure the change in optical performance under a hydrogen environment to improve the signal intensity of light intensity changes. When hydrogen gas contacts the surface of palladium, it is captured and decomposed into hydrogen atoms and enters the interior of the palladium lattice, causing physical properties of the palladium nanoparticles to change, which in turn affects the intensity of transmitted light. However, due to the very small size of the nanoparticles, the resulting changes in optical performance are limited, so this paper uses a multilayer sensitization method to enhance the intensity of the optical signal and improve the performance-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots and Visual Analysis of Global 2D-MoS2-Based Biosensors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Two-dimensional molybdenum disulfide (2D-MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) has become a promising two-dimensional material due to its unique characteristics like large specific surface area, high electron mobility, more sensitive photoluminescence performance, and low toxicity. And the studies of 2D-MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has also become a hot spot of current biosensor research. In this paper, 451 articles were selected that related to the subject of 2D-MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-based biosensors in the Web of Science Core Collection database. A multidimensional bibliometric analysis was carried out using Origin 2019pro and Citespace V. The results show that China has obvious research advantages in this field; no research institute has formed a prominent advantage in this field at present; BIOSENSORS & BIOELECTRONICS has the largest volume of papers and the largest number of co-citations in this field; HUANG KJ has done a lot of researches in this field and publishes articles with high quantity and quality, which makes him an ideal collaborator; the current research concerned the center of attention are the 2D-MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> Field-Effect Transistor (FET) and the 2D-MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> based Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) biosensor in this field.

articleTitle: Study and Practice on Control Strategy of Leader-Follower Manned-Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Formation Based on PIXHAWK Flight Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article takes the control strategy and practical method of Leader-Follower Manned-Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Formation for research purposes, choose PIXHAWK flight control system and Multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for verification platform. It analyzed the dynamic equation, the control algorithm and the process of the Leader-Follower formation flight control system. The platform applied XBeeS3B communication module structures to set up machine communication and realize the data interaction. And on the basis of setting the formation distance between aircraft, four following control strategies including following position, following speed, receiving target position signal and waiting for receiving target position signal were adopted to complete formation flight engineering verification.

articleTitle: Research on product iterative requirement analysis method based on internet review data and XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to cope with the rapid change of industrial products in the era of big data and alleviate the problems of strong subjectivity and weak timeliness of traditional product research methods, a product iterative demand analysis method based on Internet review data and XGBoost is proposed. According to the text sentiment classification results of online comment data, an analysis model of influencing factors of user satisfaction based on XGBoost is constructed. The user pain point index is measured from the importance of influencing factors of user satisfaction and user sentiment, and the improvement direction of products is determined according to the sorting of user pain point index. In view of the urgent need for iterative product attributes, negative views are extracted, and then the iterative product requirements are analyzed. Taking a best-selling SUV as an experimental case, the feasibility and effectiveness of this method are verified.

articleTitle: Research status of video image interpretation technology for photoelectric measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Video image interpretation technology is an important research direction in the field of photoelectric measurement. It refers to the technology that can extract the characteristics of the target from the photometric image, and can also accurately analyze the optical characteristics of the target. Mainly focus on real-time and automatic identification. In order to clarify the core difficulties of video image interpretation in photoelectric measurement, and to provide researchers with effective theoretical reference and trend information, this paper starts from the working principle of photoelectric tracking measurement system. First, analyzes the key technology of video image processing and research progress. On the other hand, the research history and development trend of video image interpretation system are described. Finally, comprehensive current technology development trends give thoughts and suggestions on video image interpretation technology.

articleTitle: Visualization Research of People's Livelihood Service Data based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Knowledge graph is a kind of directed graph which is used to reflect the relationship between objective world entities. It can acquire a lot of computer readable knowledge by combining with natural language processing technology. It is suitable for processing and mining large-scale and multi-modal massive data. It is a research hotspot in the field of computer knowledge engineering. People's livelihood issues are related to social stability and political stability. Solving people's livelihood problems is an important task for the Party and the state. At present, how to visualize and retrieve relevant data in the field of people's livelihood services is still in its infancy. for the data in this service platform, knowledge graph technology has been used to realize the association and visualization of all kinds of data. it is of great significance and reference value for data mining and analysis in the field of people's livelihood and providing decision support for the government.

articleTitle: Simulation of land use change in central Yunnan based on FLUS model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Land use/land cover change (LUCC) is the most direct manifestation of the interaction between human activities and the natural environment [1]. The simulation of land use/cover change has important practical significance for the intensive use of land and the sustainable and healthy development of the social economy. The FLUS model was constructed by artificial neural network and other methods, and after verifying the accuracy, the land use pattern of central Yunnan in 2025 was simulated and predicted. The results showed that: garden land decreased by 9km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(12%), cultivated land decreased by 256km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(1.23%), forest land increased by 290km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(0.37%), construction land increased by 45km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(3.4%); water area decreased by 6.48km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(0.71%), and finally discussed large area New problems exposed in the forecasting process.

articleTitle: The Design of ACE Fly by wire system fault monitoring based on CPLD
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to meet the aircraft reliability requirement, the actuator control electronics(ACE) based on the new concept in Fly by wire system(FBW) was study. ACE working principle, hardware components and software design were introduced. ACE double slip design, working mode and CPLD-based fault monitoring mechanism were focused on. The Integrated fault monitoring method based on self-monitoring, comparative monitoring and joint monitoring of software and hardware were used. Redundancy design method was adopted, according to its own fault information, the actuator controller is divided into three working modes: normal mode, direct mode and damping mode. Through the testing experiment on the controller, it is showed that the system is stable and reliable.

articleTitle: Image classification optimization and results analysis based on VGG network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Classification accuracy and network performance are affected by many factors while classifying Image by convolution neural network. The paper takes garbage image classification as an example, the common performance optimization methods of garbage image classification by using VGGNet model were summarized. And VGG-16 was used to test the target data set of garbage image. The classification accuracy under different conditions was measured and compared. Finally, the performance of the parameters under different optimization schemes is analyzed.

articleTitle: Improved Visual Background Extractor Based on Motion Saliency
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Motion detection has been widely applied as the fundamental step of video analysis. In this paper, we present a technique for extracting the moving objects from video sequences, which is based on the off-the-shelf visual background extractor (ViBe) method. In order to improve the performance of ViBe, a series of modifications are introduced. First, inspired by the saliency detection model, the differences between the pixels of the coming frame and all its corresponding background samples are accumulated and the motion saliency map is generated, by which it can suppress the inaccuracy of the background model in that it takes all the samples into consideration instead of parts of them. Second, based on the above saliency maps, the modified fuzzy growing method is applied to extract the foreground mask. Experiments on a variety of visual surveillance databases validate the improvements of the proposed modifications. Especially in a scenario where the moving objects stop for a short while, our method can greatly suppress the diffusion of false negatives.

articleTitle: Feature extraction method of analog circuit based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The signals of early fault analog circuits are weak, and it is difficult to extract the depth and essential features by using the traditional extraction method. In addition, the extracted features are easy to overlap. To solve these problems, a novel optimization deep belief network (DBN) for extracting circuit features is proposed in this paper. which uses particle swarm optimization to optimize the number of neurons in the hidden layer, so as to determine the optimal network structure. At the same time, it can overcome the deficiency that many attempts should be paid to set the number of neurons according to experience, and improve the effectiveness of feature extraction furtherly. This method digs the feature information from the original data directly, and it has strong characterization ability, which overcomes the dependence of the traditional feature extraction method on the knowledge of signal processing. So the project is easy to realize. The validity of this method was verified by using the simulation of the Sallen-Key filter circuit. The results confirm that the characteristics of the different fault categories extracted by this method have better separation. The redundancy of features was reduced, besides, the accuracy of subsequent health state monitoring and residual life prediction was improved.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-object-oriented Automatic Defense Technology for ARP Attack
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: ARP-attack often occurs in LAN network [1], which directly affects the user's online experience. The common type of ARP-attack is MITM-Attack (Man-in-the-Middle Attack) with two-types, disguising a host or a gateway. Common means of ARP-attack prevention is by deploying network-security equipment or binding IP-MAC in LAN manually[10]. This paper studies an automatic ARP-attack prevention technology for multi-object, based on the domain-control technology and batch-processing technology. Compared with the common ARP-attack-prevention measure, this study has advantages of low-cost, wide-application, and maintenance-free. By experimentally researching, this paper demonstrates the research correctness and technical feasibility. This research result, multi-object-oriented automatic defense technology for ARP-attacking, can apply to enterprise network.

articleTitle: License Plate Location Detection Algorithm based on Two-dimensional Gamma Function
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For vehicle images under uneven illumination, a two-dimensional gamma function adaptive brightness correction algorithm is proposed to reduce the influence of uneven illumination and license plate positioning is realized. Firstly, the image is converted from RGB to HSI and the three components are separated. Tonal H remains unchanged and saturation S is stretched by contrast. Multi-scale Gaussian function is used to extract the illumination component of the brightness I and two-dimensional gamma function is constructed for adaptive brightness correction to obtain a new brightness component TI. The three components are combined to obtain a new HSI color image. Then, the vehicle image after correction is preprocessed and sobel edge detection is also carried out. Finally, the license plate location is realized by using the geometric features of the license plate. The experimental results show that this method can effectively locate the vehicle images both at night and under uneven illumination.

articleTitle: Research on Member Digital Marketing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Members, as the most important customers of the mall, are closely related to the continuous development of the mall. In order to study the digital marketing strategies of shopping mall members that meet the current market needs, establish a conversion rate model and monthly consumption growth rate model for members of different levels, and predict the total value of shopping mall members' consumption in the coming year. Finally, an example analysis verifies the feasibility and rationality of the model. The results show that the upgrade conversion rates of ordinary card→Nanchang ordinary card, Nanchang ordinary card→VIP card, VIP card→Platinum card are: 7.43%, 5.85%, 22.20%, Platinum card→VIP card, VIP card→Nanchang ordinary card, Nanchang ordinary card→ downgrade conversion rate of ordinary card are: 18.49%, 18.23%, 5.26% respectively. In the next year, the total value of consumption of shopping mall members will increase by 16.13% over the previous year, reaching 313688357. The research results are conducive to the sustainable development of shopping malls and provide a theoretical basis for members' digital marketing strategies.

articleTitle: Volume characteristic calculation based on CATIA secondary development
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Volume characteristic database generation is an important part of aircraft fuel measurement. In order to establish the volume characteristic database quickly and accurately, CATIA secondary development is applied to automatically generate the volume characteristic database of each attitude angle and liquid level. The numerical accuracy of the fuel volume characteristic established in this paper is up to 100%, which indicates that the calculation method of fuel volume characteristic is accurate and feasible, and can provide a reference method for the establishment of similar fuel volume characteristic database.

articleTitle: Research on Improved BP Neural Network Blast Vibration Frequency Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the blasting vibration frequency prediction model, a factor analysis method is combined with the BP neural network method to propose an improved BP neural network blasting vibration frequency prediction model. The actual field data of the project is selected to test the accuracy of the improved BP neural network network blasting vibration frequency prediction model. The final result: the relative average error between the predicted value and the actual value of the 20 groups of training samples is 4.89%. The errors are 6.75%, 5.68%, 5.69%, 4.64%, 4.90%, 6.35%, 3.56%, and the average relative error is 5.37%, both of which are less than 10%, proving that the improved BP neural network prediction model has good prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A Global MPPT Optimization Algorithm for Commercial Aerospace
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The power system of the new commercial satellite adopts maximum power point tracking (MPPT) unregulated bus architecture to improve solar energy utilization. To further improve the tracking power of MPPT control technique, a dynamic small-signal model of the voltage-type load Superbuck converter with CCM mode is established by using the state-space averaging approach. Meanwhile, the mathematical model of the parallel solar array is simplified, and a fast and stable global MPPT optimization algorithm without adding any additional hardware circuit is proposed according to the proportion between the peak point value of parallel solar array and the open circuit voltage and the short circuit current of solar unit. The local searching is used instead of global searching during the closed-loop voltage control. When it is applied to the power module of unregulated bus, it can successfully realize the global MPPT. An experimental platform is built upon a hundred-watt superbuck converter to verify the effectiveness and quickness of the global MPPT optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Positioning Work Area Based on China loran C System GDOP
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The distribution of the geometric positions of the ground navigation stations determines the Geometric Dilution of Precision (GDOP), which is also one of the important factors determining the positioning accuracy of the system. This paper develops a GDOP simulation study of the traditional hyperbolic positioning mode for the Chinese loran C positioning system, constructs the geographical distribution map of the system's GDOP in China, and analyzes the system's high-precision positioning area, common working area, and The distribution of the sea areas and inland areas corresponding to the positioning area provides an important reference for maritime and inland users to maximize the use of the Loran C system positioning service, ensuring user navigation safety.

articleTitle: Image Saliency Detection Based on Contrast Feature of Superpixel Patch
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Saliency detection based on visual attention mechanism is one of the current researches focuses of computer vision. In this paper, an image saliency detection algorithm based on the contrast feature of superpixel patch is proposed. First, RGB color space image is transformed into HSV color space, and color saliency is calculated. Then, the SLI C algorithm is used to construct the superpixel patch structure of the image. In LAB color space, the contrast saliency is calculated. Finally, the salient images of color feature and contrast feature are fused and multi-scale enhanced. Image saliency detection is carried out on MSRA - 1000 data set. Compared with the existing methods, the algorithm in this paper detects more complete contour of image saliency region, has better precision and recall rate, and can obviously suppress complex texture and noise.

articleTitle: An algorithm for vertex distinguishing total coloring of Graphs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, the vertex distinguishing total chromatic number of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>-E(H)(n ≥ 3) is obtained by using the algorithm, studied some graphs G to meet χ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vdtc</sub>(G)=|G|+2 when such that a certain condition. Where K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> be a complete graph of order n(n ≡ 1(mod2)), H be a subgraph such as some matchings, a path, a cycle, a star, a fan, a wheel, a complete graph and a bipartite complete graph. Based on the previous above, authors put forward some conjectures. Especially, a conjecture belongs to necessary condition of complete graph G when χ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vdtc</sub>(G)=|G|+2.

articleTitle: Edge Computing-based Defect Identification Model of Power IoT Edge Side Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: There are various types of devices on the terminal side of the power Internet of Things, and the data collected through various sensors shows an exponential growth. The current in-depth application of edge computing technology can not only ease the pressure of network transmission, but also improve the timeliness of fault diagnosis. Edge computing technology is A new way to solve the fault diagnosis of equipment on the edge of the power grid. From the perspective of edge fault diagnosis, this paper expounds the fault diagnosis model of power IoT edge devices based on edge computing, and combines the isolated forest algorithm to design smart sensor data-based power IoT edge device fault diagnosis algorithms. Finally, the validity of the proposed framework model is verified by public sample data.

articleTitle: Transformer-PSS: A High-Efficiency Prosodic Speech Synthesis Model based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Much attention has been given to prosodic speech synthesis with the progress of human-computer interaction and automatic content generation. However, one of its disadvantages is high computational complexity which makes it hard to train and inference. Most of the popular models, such as GST-Tacotron, use a recursive decoder to generate the Mel spectrum frame-by-frame which might be the main bottleneck restraining their calculation speed. In this paper, we propose Transformer-PSS, a high-efficiency prosodic speech synthesis model that employs the transformer architecture to generate Mel spectrum in a non-autoregressive way. Experiments show that our model is 4.6x faster than popular models and have better generative quality on objective evaluations.

articleTitle: New Model and Application of Security Region for Metering Device Status Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With a large number of smart metering device installation and application, the power companies can get a variety of information such as metering device via a communication network. Considering the needs of grid state estimation for metering device, we propose a new security domain model network metering devices at the same time on the measurement network analysis, given the security system of metering device. The algorithm of calculating the network security domain by using metering device is designed in this paper. Through the security domain model and AHP in obtaining network security at the same time measuring device, given the state of metering devices affect the reliability of the key factors is estimated to improve the state estimation accuracy and timeliness.

articleTitle: Dynamic Network Community Detection Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of information technology in China more and more powerful, the development and reform of information transformation has an impact on many industries, and the necessity of network information security is becoming stronger and stronger. In the context of the increase of the security requirements of cyberspace, big data label technology has been gradually effectively applied, the reform and development of this technology makes the intelligent analysis method of power grid monitoring become a reality, the security situation awareness of power grid monitoring is the most direct embodiment of this technology. Security situational awareness for behavior identification, security assessment, prediction and other functions to carry out research, research these problems can finally achieve security support, continuous analysis of network security, prevention of malicious attacks and information theft is an important work in the operation of the power grid. The defense capability of the power grid monitoring system network in the operation process must be automated, this paper takes the intelligent analysis method of power grid monitoring as the research object, takes the big data tag technology as the technical support, studies the information and prediction of electric network security situation, and puts forward the author's personal opinion and opinion.

articleTitle: Multiplexing Difference in Epilepsy under sleep and wakefulness condition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Epilepsy is a fatal brain disease which affects nervous system and even partial epilepsy involves in global changes around the brain. Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals records the post-synaptic potentials of hundreds of neurons in the brain, which contains multiple source regions and offers subjective representation of brain condition. Complex network and graph theory are adopted for quantitative measurement exploitation. In this paper, patients with double temporal lobe epilepsy (dTLE) are enrolled and their EEG signals under sleep as well as awake condition are recorded. In order to detect functional connectivity, phase locking value (PLV) is brought in for measuring narrow-band interactions. Then the consensus clustering algorithm is implemented to separate individual nodes and dominant sets for discovering representative modular structure. Experimental results demonstrate that the cohesion in community member becomes tighter in dTLE group than controls. What's more, delta band, alpha band and lower gamma band renders alterations according to the variation of information analysis on subgraph distance. These results indicate that modular structure discovery and quantifications offers another choice of biomarkers for epilepsy in clinical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks for Mobile Face Recognition with Hierarchical Feature integration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Significant advances in face recognition tasks have been made with the development of convolutional neural networks. With large scale convolutional neural networks we are now able to achieve 99% accuracy on many public face test sets. However, the face recognition networks commonly used for mobile are limited by their narrow network width which makes it difficult to learn better distributed features in face recognition feature embedding learning. In this work, based on MobileFaceNets we propose an attention-guided hierarchical feature fusion model. Compared with the traditional cascading convolutional neural network classification model, our approach can explicitly consider both global and local features. And our approach requires only a small increase in computation to obtain better results than directly increasing the feature dimension.

articleTitle: Research on Task Scheduling Algorithm Based on Fuzzy Logic Priority
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of phased array radar technology, the research on task scheduling of phased array radar is more and more extensive and in-depth.
