In order to adapt to the task scheduling in complex environment, a task scheduling algorithm for phased array radar based on fuzzy logic priority is proposed. In this paper, firstly, the scheduling model of phased array radar tracking task is constructed. Then the fuzzy logic method is optimized, and the main influencing factors such as range, velocity, threat and hostility are selected to determine the priority of the task. The deterministic method is applied to the adaptive task scheduling algorithm based on scheduling interval and time pointer, and the scheduling algorithm based on time pointer is improved. Finally, the simulation results show that the improved algorithm can effectively reduce the time offset while ensuring the time utilization.

articleTitle: Research On the Optimization Algorithm of Missile Initial Shooting Azimuth
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This The traditional initial shooting azimuth algorithm of the missile is different of the azimuth angle when calculating the azimuth angle, Multiple ballistic iteration processes are needed to make the placement of missiles meet the accuracy requirements of shooting, in view of the above problems, in this paper, an initial shooting azimuth optimization algorithm for long-range missiles considering the influence of earth rotation is proposed, Through simulation verification, It is proved that the method can converge quickly to the result of calculating the basic shooting data.

articleTitle: Research on Bandwidth Allocation for Synchronization System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The bandwidth allocation of the current synchronization system mainly relies on the presetting priorities, thus lacks comprehensive consideration of data size, arrival time of data, and users who receive the data. In this article the utility function of the synchronization system is defined with the waiting time of users as the starting point, and a dynamic data priority strategy is proposed by maximizing the utility function. When the utility function is linear, data can be transmitted in a modified priority order. For non-linear cases, an approximate solution can be obtained through the simulated annealing algorithm. The bandwidth allocation strategy proposed in this paper reasonably takes into account factors such as user priority, system priority, data size, arrival time of data, and can be applied in the actual synchronization systems.

articleTitle: Improving Mobile Network Performance with Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Most cloud-based applications utilize a cloud server to handle data produced by various terminal devices, including smart devices and wearable devices. The above model has big negative effect on user experience. Furthermore, the emergence of some new computing applications, including automatic drive and virtual reality, has become possible because of availability of abundant cloud resources. Nonetheless, the delay-sensitive applications have strict response time requirements. The existing computing model does not have capability to meet the above demand. Based on the above phenomenon, Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) has been suggested to bring cloud resources, such as computation and storage resources, to the edge network. Now, MEC is considered as a good method to reduce the workload on the cloud server and to reduce response time for mobile users. In this paper, the definition of the MEC is presented. Then, we discuss several typical applications of MEC. Also, we describe some key research challenges in MEC scenario. In the end, we highlight the critical points and conclude this paper.

articleTitle: A time-dependent reliability analysis method based on neural network response surface
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Uncertainty exists widely in the engineering field, and the reliability of products has time-dependent characteristics due to the accumulation of product use time and material performance degradation. Traditional time-dependent reliability solutions such as span rate and Monte Carlo are difficult to be applied in engineering practice due to their complex principles and low computational efficiency. Therefore, this paper proposes a time-dependent reliability analysis method based on neural network response surface learned form the idea of limit value. This method uses inverse reliability sampling and establishes a response surface model between the design variables and the limit value of the limit state function to convert the time-dependent reliability into time-invariant reliability. Then, the traditional method is used to solve the time-dependent reliability, which improves calculation efficiency and accuracy of time-dependent reliability analysis. Finally, two examples are used to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A method of establishing a branch image library to realize the shared application environment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The development, operation and maintenance of software products require more and more teams to collaborate. The technology of sharing application environments through custom images has emerged, but the existing versions of shared custom images are not iterative. The environment build error is difficult to fall back to the correct version of the previously built image, and the changes made by the different users to the image environment are likely to be overwritten. Therefore, this paper proposes a way to establish a branch image library and a mirror version library to solve the above problems.

articleTitle: A Threshold Denoising Method for Ultrasonic Signal Based on CEEMDAN and Spatial Correlation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The strong noise in the ultrasonic signal of coarse-grained materials is difficult to be effectively eliminated by traditional denoising methods. A threshold de noising method for ultrasonic signal based on Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) and spatial correlation is proposed. The ultrasonic signal is decomposed into a series of intrinsic modal functions (IMFs) by CEEMDAN, and then the IMFs to be processed are chosen adaptively by the CMSE criterion. The local correlation coefficient between the corresponding IMFs of the ultrasonic signals from adj acent detection points is calculated as the reconstruction coefficient of each IMF after being thresholded, and finally the noise-reduced ultrasonic signal is obtained. Simulation analysis results show that the proposed method has significantly better de noising effect than the comparison methods, and the reconstructed echo signal is more accurate.

articleTitle: The Analysis method and application of connection of transformer winding based on current phasor diagram
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Yd-type-transformers are widely used in power systems, and there are six types of connection of transformer winding. The line voltage method is complex and error-prone to determine the connection group. A new analysis method based on current phasor is proposed, which can determine the connection mode of winding quickly and accurately before installation and can be applied to the qualitative and quantitative analysis of the system after installation. This method has important guiding significance for practical work.

articleTitle: Temperature Optimization Control of CSTR
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Continuously Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) is a common chemical reaction vessel in chemical production. It is widely used in the chemical industry. The safety of its control system is very important. The CSTR system has some difficult points that are difficult to overcome, and its system itself has strong time-delay characteristics and nonlinearity, resulting in most of its control systems with complex and robust algorithms, and relatively poor realtime performance. This article adopts the dynamic performance of CSTR After in-depth analysis of the insufficiency of static performance, the characteristic difference and complementary advantages of the clamp and coil cooling system in the CSTR are used to propose a dual optimization control scheme for CSTR temperature. This strategy uses the high efficiency of coil cooling to quickly eliminate the temperature. The purpose of the deviation, on the other hand, makes it more reasonable by using the economy of the clamp cooling system. Among them, the temperature controller adopts fuzzy PID control algorithm, and the valve position controller of clamp cooling adopts human-like PID algorithm. Finally, through the simulation results, the coordinated temperature control strategy designed in this paper gives full play to the complementary advantages of clamp and coil cooling, and achieves the purpose of energy saving and consumption reduction. The above method is also applicable to other production systems with similar structures.

articleTitle: Hankel tensor approximation using structured approach
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Hankel tensor is an important tool in the field of signal processing, and the low-rank approximation of the Hankel tensor can be used for signal restoration. Aiming at the low rank approximation problem of real Hankel tensor, this paper proves that there is a special form of Vandermonde decomposition for real Hankel tensor. Based on this form of decomposition, a low-rank approximation algorithm is proposed, which can ensure that the result of the approximation is still real Hankel tensor. This paper confirms that the algorithm can solve the optimal Vandermonde rank-one approximation and Vandermonde decomposition, and uses signal denoising as examples to illustrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: ANN-inversion Based Fractional-Order Sliding Control for the Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To improve the control performance of the industrial robot, an ANN-inversion based fractional order sliding mode control(FOSMC) scheme is proposed. Firstly, the BP neural network is used for the inversion of the industrial robot, and approximate decoupling and linearization of the industrial robot is got. Secondly, the composite pseudo linear system, w hich is composed of the ANN-Inversion system and the con-trolled industrial robot, is equivalent to a linear system with disturbance in view of the industrial robot uncer-tainties and the BP neural network's approximation error. Then, the fractional-order sliding control(FOS-MC) scheme is proposed based on the SM Ctheory and fractional calculus for the linear system with disturb-ance, and the stability analysis is given. Finally, case study is fulfilled for a two -DOF robot under different conditions, and results show the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Research on balance strategy of Aviation Lithium Battery
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Battery energy balance circuit is mainly divided into Buck-Boost circuit and Cuk circuit, in this paper, the charging and discharging model of aviation lithium battery is built based on the principles of two kinds of circuits, the problem of SOC imbalance in the process of charge and discharge of aviation lithium battery is studied. Combined with the characteristics of aviation lithium battery and aviation equipment, and according to the principle of circuit simplification and control algorithm simplification, in this paper, the central threshold method is used to control the charge and discharge of the two equalizing circuits. According to the experimental results, Buck-Boost circuit has simple structure, strong plasticity and Cuk circuit has high conversion efficiency, which determines the objective law of the construction of lithium battery equalization circuit.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling Decision System of Coal Mine Roadway Repair Machine Based on Optimized Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the optimized configuration, dynamic scheduling and management level of the machine group in the construction process of the coal mine roadway repair machine, the construction progress, engineering quality and economic benefits of the whole project were directly determined. In order to meet the needs of safe and efficient repair and treatment of the coal mine roadway floor heave, this paper put forward the optimization configuration principle of the roadway repair machine group construction, and a multi-objective optimal allocation model was established with the construction cost and the comprehensive utilization rate of the unit shift cost as the objective function. The optimal scheduling decision scheme was obtained by solving the configuration model with particle swarm optimization algorithm. Finally, two examples were given to verify the practicability of the model and the feasibility of the algorithm to solve the problem. The research results provided a theoretical basis for the scheduling decision-making of the roadway repair machine construction, at the same time, it provided the basis and method for improving the mechanized construction level of the machine group.

articleTitle: On the Knowledge Graphs of Postgraduate Entrance English Examination Based on WordNet and D3.js
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To reveal visually the semantic composition of high-frequency words in postgraduate entrance English examination for the students to have better understanding and memorization of the words in the examination outline and the high-frequency words, this paper presents the network structure of these high-frequency words via visualized knowledge graphs and the network structure of the words in the examination outline in WordNet, optimizes further WordNet to draw a concise and lucid semantic network by means of such corpus sources as WordNet (a semantic dictionary), D3.js (a visualized library) and British National Corpus. In the meantime, the paper gives consideration to the time-effectiveness of the content and the examination outline and adopts the test papers of postgraduate entrance English (1) examination during 2015-2020. In addition, a secondary function including the retrieval of long and difficult sentences for the quicker learning of the key content of the examination by the students is derived from the main function of the semantic visualization of the words.

articleTitle: Tire damage image recognition based on improved convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the application of tire damage image recognition, the use of convolutional neural network to train the model needs to extract the feature information of the tire image, and when judging the feature information, it is prone to overfitting, which reduces the training accuracy of the algorithm. To solve this problem, an image recognition algorithm based on convolutional neural network and ridge regression analysis is proposed. A new regular term is introduced into the original loss function of the algorithm, in order to change the ratio of the two parts in the new loss function, and reduce the jitter of the fitted curve of the feature information. Finally, it is verified through experiments that the improved convolutional neural network algorithm can improve the training accuracy and image recognition rate of tire damaged images.

articleTitle: Steel Plate Surface Defect Image Enhancement Based on Adaptive Fractional Differentiation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: During the steel plate collection process, affected by the light and shooting angle, the image of the surface defect of the steel plate will have blurred traces. In order to improve clarity, the image needs to be enhanced. Aiming at the problems of traditional image enhancement algorithms that require multiple trials to find the optimal order, based on the self-similarity of image local information, an improved adaptive fractional differential mathematical model is established, and this model is substituted into the improved 16-direction Tiansi mask. The image is enhanced in the template. Experiments show that the enhanced defect image significantly highlights the texture details of the defect image while retaining the smooth area, which is a preparation for the subsequent improvement of the accuracy of defect image classification.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Communication Quality Analysis Method in Electricity Information Collection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of abnormal wireless communication quality status in the electrical information collection system and difficulty in troubleshooting. This paper proposes a system based on the improvement of the communication protocol of the distribution automation system to monitor the wireless communication status of the acquisition terminal. The system analyzes the status data reported by the wireless communication module of the acquisition terminal to achieve an effective evaluation of communication quality. Effectively improve the efficiency of analyzing the wireless communication quality status of the acquisition terminal, and greatly reduce the cost of manual investigation.

articleTitle: Testing and Maintenance System of Automatic Weather Station Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large number types of automatic weather stations, inconsistent fault detection standards and low degree of automation, this paper studies and designs an automatic weather station test and maintenance system based on virtual instrument technology. The system is based on PXI bus measuring instrument of NI company and is modeled by LabView graphic programming software. It realizes the functions of performance testing, parameter measurement, intelligent analysis and fault diagnosis of meteorological observation equipment collector and sensor, Maintenance efficiency has been increased by more than 60%. It has been popularized and applied in provincial meteorological departments in China.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling of Linear Phase-shifting Transformer Inverter System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on the working principle of 12-phase multi-superposition inverter of Linear phase-shifting transformer, the theoretical basis of square wave's synthesis of multi-step waves and the principle of phase configuration in phase-shifting superposition are briefly introduced. The mathematical model of the inverter system is established in Simulink, and the solution process is completed by s-function in Matlab. The results of calculation and analysis show that the waveform quality of this new 12-phase multi-overlapping inverter is good, and it can basically meet the requirements of power conversion. Finally, the feasibility of the theory and simulation analysis is verified by experiments, which provides a strong support for the following prototype optimization.

articleTitle: The Application of CI-CSCKF Fusion in Tracking the Mid-Course of Boost-Glide Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, boost-glide vehicles have been widely studied in the military field of various powers. Because boost-glide vehicles can still generate maneuverability and high maneuverability in the free-glide segment, the traditional dynamic model-based tracking method is no longer applicable in this field. Due to the multisensor fusion tracking effect is superior to the single sensor tracking, combined with the field of maneuvering target tracking commonly used “current” statistical model, and compared with the UKF, nonlinear filter such as CKF filter has better stability and smaller computation. CS-CKF tracking model was constructed, and through the two radar observations, using the theory of Covariance Intersection (CI) fusion of two groups of observation data integration CI-CSCKF fusion. Simulation results show that the estimation effect of CI-CSCKF fusion algorithm is better than the tracking effect of single sensor based on CSCKF.

articleTitle: Improved Virtual Network Embedding Algorithm based on Hausdorff Distance
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The virtual network embedding aims to effectively, efficiently and robustly embed virtual nodes and virtual links requested by virtual networks to the resources of physical networks. Previous studies focused on designing of heuristic algorithms or trying to solve the problem through a two-stage solution. The node embedding was the first stage and the link embedding was the second stage. An improved virtual network embedding algorithm based on Hausdorff distance is proposed, which uses Hausdorff distance to describe the similarity between nodes in physical networks and virtual networks from multiple dimensions. The virtual network embedding problem is defined as an integral programming problem consisting of an objective function and some constraints by establishing an enhanced physical network model. Then the optimal embedding result can be obtained by solving this mathematical problem. A topologically related factor will be added to the objective function. This method can solve the problem of the virtual network embedding in one step. It can be known from the simulation results clearly that this algorithm can greatly improve the performance acceptance rate, increase the revenue-cost ratio and the revenue while reduce the cost of the virtual network embedding.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Hydrogen Leak Concentration based on Improved PSO-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The change of ambient temperature and humidity will affect the measurement accuracy of hydrogen leakage sensor, resulting in false alarm or missed alarm. Based on the analysis of the influence of environmental temperature and humidity changes on the sensor measurement results, this paper proposes a nonlinear compensation scheme based on improved pso-bp neural network (PSO-BP). We combine PSO algorithm and BP neural network, and optimize pso-bp neural network by adopting the strategy of adjusting relevant parameters according to the changing trend of individual fitness value, aiming at the deficiency of precocious convergence caused by the fixed related parameters of PSO algorithm during the training process of the network. The experiment shows that the improved pso-bp neural network can effectively reduce the influence of environmental temperature and humidity on the sensor, and has a good compensation.

articleTitle: Application of intelligent control technology in aero-generator's overload protection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: When the aero-generator is overloaded, the power distribution system will carry out overload protection control. The overload protection action time is one important parameter. If the action time is too long, the aero-generator may be burnt down; on the other hand, if the action time is too short, it is easy to cause the electrical power supply fluctuation and reduce the power supply quality. Therefore, in order to effectively realize the overload protection control of aero-generator, the key problem is how to determine the best action time. In this paper, an intelligent control (fuzzy control) method will be used to determine the optimal overload protection action time to improve the power supply quality and prolong the service life of the aero-generator, which makes the overload protection control more intelligent and advanced for the electrical power supply system.

articleTitle: Visualization Analysis on the Application of Molybdenum Disulfide in Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Ultra thin two-dimensional materials have attracted lots of attention since the monolayer graphene was first successfully deposited by mechanical exfoliation in 2004 by British scientists. Since then, grapheme-like-materials, such as MoS2 have become a new research hotspot. Based on the Web of Science Core collection database, this study visually analyzed the research status of application of MoS2 in the sensors since 1996 to 2019 by using co-citation, citation burst, and keyword co-occurrence functions of software CiteSpace. This paper aims to scientifically and accurately recognize the trends and challenges in the development of MoS2 -based gas sensors.

articleTitle: Research on 3d Reconstruction of Target based on Double Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For the 3D imaging needs of the target in virtual reality, a black background is constructed with the help of binocular stereo vision technology. Through panoramic image acquisition of the target, ORB feature matching and ICP point cloud registration are used to generate 3D panoramic point cloud data of the target. In view of the point cloud data generated, after filtering, get all non-zero target information and zero background information, build a minimum circumscribed cube., the transformation of coordinates of the point cloud data and generate a normalized coordinate of the point cloud data. After the experiment, the 3D reconstruction effect of the target under pure black background is better than that including the background. After the coordinate normalization, the reconstructed target can be rotated and scaled, which can reflect the texture characteristics of the target and provide data support for the target to be transplanted into virtual.

articleTitle: Iterative method for upward extrapolation of underwater electric potential induced by a warship
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For the upward extrapolation of underwater electric potential, induced by a warship, the boundary condition is not complete, so the upward extrapolation can not be achieved by solving the Laplace equation. To realize the upward extrapolation, an iterative algorithm based on boundary integral method was used in this paper, which can use the downward extrapolation method as a medium and achieving upward extrapolation by a error adjustment mechanism. By using the expanded interpolated potential, the feasibility of this method was tested. And results show that the extrapolation errors are small and mainly concentrated in the edge area of target plane, which implies the accuracy of the iterative extrapolation algorithm is pretty high.

articleTitle: Leaky Rectangular Waveguide with 1.7Ghz Radiation Field
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a structure of leaky rectangular waveguide working at 1.7Ghz by using BJ18. The parameters of this structure are designed by simulation software CST. And radiation characteristics are analyzed by a hybrid method combining a full-wave method for near-field computation and an integral method for far-field computation. This kind of leaky rectangular waveguide can be applied in rail transportation systems and accordingly it will enhance the receiving signal, suppress the interference and improve the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Complex-valued Globally Projected Dynamical Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The globally projected dynamical system is a type of dynamical system constructed by the projection operator, which can be applied to solve some nonmonotone variational inequalities and constrained optimization problems. In this paper we extend the globally projected dynamical system to the complex domain and study the dynamical behaviors of the complex-valued globally projected dynamical system. By using energy-like function, Lyapunov stability method, space decomposition approach and inequality technique, the stability of linear and nonlinear complex-valued globally projected dynamical systems is studied. The simulation result shows the effectiveness of the obtained results.

Author Keywords: globally projected dynamical system complex-valued neural network

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Mechatronic System for Releasing and Recycling of Nanomagnetic-insulin
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A fully implantable artificial pancreas system with intraperitoneal glucose sensing and insulin releasing has the advantage of a fast insulin response and no psychological burden to diabetic patients. However, it may require frequent surgical interventions to refill insulin after insulin is used out. By studying the metabolic pathway of insulin, in this paper we propose a mechatronic system for releasing and recycling of nanomagnetic -insulin to demonstrate the feasibility of achieving magnetic-assisted insulin recycle and reuse, which may reduce the needs of insulin refill and mitigate hypoglycemia. In the prototype developed in this study, the mechanical structure, driving principle, control circuit and related programming of the mechatronic system are introduced. Finally, the basic functions of the mechatronic prototype are verified by ex vivo experiments.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Influence Factors Measured by HPGe$\gamma$ spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to ensure the reliability of HPGeγ spectrometer, the influencing factors were analyzed and modeled, and the simulation software was designed for calculation. The obtained data were in good agreement with the experimental results. The results show that the most important factors affecting the measurement reliability of HPGeγ spectrometer are the activity of scale source and the efficiency of total energy peak. It is necessary to select the scale source with small error and high activity in the actual measurement to reduce the artificial operation error and improve the measurement reliability. The simulation software can be used for the measurement and reliability evaluation of HPGeγ spectrometer in laboratory, which can improve the measurement time.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Ant Colony Algorithm in Flight Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a new improved ant colony algorithm is proposed, which solves the problems of local optimization and premature stagnation when the traditional algorithm is applied to flight path planning. By describing the path planning problem, the mathematical model of path planning in the intelligent guidance of aircraft is built, and the known terrain and threat information in the flight area are integrated to reduce the data space. Based on the dynamic constraints of aircraft flight, a constraint model including maneuverability constraints and external threat constraints is built and integrated into the terrain information. The intelligent guidance path is planned by constructing a path synthesis cost function that satisfies the kinematics of the aircraft. The ant colony algorithm is selected from the modern heuristic algorithm and improved. Simulation results show that the algorithm can avoid terrain obstacles effectively, has the lowest comprehensive cost, meets the requirements of maneuverability and spatial accessibility, and basically achieves the expected goal.

articleTitle: Point Cloud Preprocessing on 3D LiDAR data for Unmanned Surface Vehicle in Marine Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Point cloud preprocessing is still a challenging task in the marine environment, for it is difficult to filter out non-obstacle points while avoiding damage to the obstacle completeness. In this paper, we propose a novel data preprocessing method on 3D LiDAR data for the unmanned surface vehicle in the marine environment. It consists of two tasks: outlier removal and wake filtering. As the spatial resolution of LiDAR changes with distance, we exploit distance normalization on statistical outlier filter for robust outlier removal. Considering the gradient difference between wave wake and obstacle surface near the water, we define and calculate the vertical state of point cloud on the range image to obtain the pre-filtering point set, and then use the RANSAC method to filter out the wake points. Experiments on real data has demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm both in terms of feasibility and accuracy.

articleTitle: Various Matchings of Graphic Groups For Graphic Lattices In Topological Coding
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: New security methods based on lattice cryptography emerge today. It has been shown that topological coding made by topological structures and mathematical restrictions can be used to serve information security, since the Number String Decomposition Problem of topological coding is NP-hard. We aim to producing topological coding, encrypting networks wholly and finding matching of twin graphic groups, multiple-graphic groups for serving the construction of graphic lattices. New coloring/labellings, matching-type graphic groups and infinite graphic groups will be discussed, a new Wait-filling Topcode-matrices Problem will be proposed.

articleTitle: The Importance Weighted Autoencoder in End-to-End Speech Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The modeling of style when synthesizing speech from text aim to enrich the emotional expression of synthesized speech. In this paper, the importance weighted autoencoder(IWAE) is introduced into Tacotron, an end-to-end speech synthesis system, to learn the latent representation of speaking styles independent of text content in an unsupervised way. Compared with the Variational Autoencoder(VAE), a generative model that can be used to model prior data distribution, IWAE has a strictly tighter variational lower bound derive from different weighted importance. In the proposed network, we input the style representation, learned by IWAE, into Tacotron to generate speech with more rhythmic. Finally, the proposed model shows better performance of speech quality in both objective and subjective ways compared to Global Style Token (GST) and VAE-Tacotron.

articleTitle: Efficient Bearing Fault Diagnosis by Fast-Residual Network With 2-D Representation of Vibration Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Effective intelligent bearing fault diagnosis has long been a research focus on the condition monitoring of rotary machinery systems. Traditional diagnosis methods require complex computation of feature vectors and rely on domain knowledge and diagnostic expertise. In recent years, many deep learning-based methods have been applied in this field, such as deep belief network and convolutional neural network. However, these diagnosis methods are hard to train and lack of efficiency. In this paper, we use a new residual network structure to solve the bearing fault diagnosis problem. Firstly, we give a brief description to the original residual network. Then, we redesign the structure and propose a new paradigm: Fast-Residual Network. To fit in the new model, we develop an effective pre-processing method using frequency slice wavelet transform and shape the one-dimensional representation signals to two-dimensional representation image. The final experimental results show that proposed model achieves higher classification and is faster and more accurate than other deep learning-based models.

articleTitle: Drug Audit Based on Different Models and Different Feature Extraction Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The audit data has the characteristics of large amount and complex form, and the current drug audit mostly rely on database methods, resulting in low audit efficiency. Although k-means and other clustering algorithms have been studied in the field of auditing, there are problems of poor clustering effect and low accuracy. To accelerate the intellectualization of drug audit in the era of big data, this paper proposes six experimental schemes based on k-means clustering model, Random Forest classification model, Multi-Layer Perceptron classification model and two feature extraction methods to conduct drug expiration audit on a hospital's drug delivery data in 2019. Then the most suitable model and feature extraction method for drug expiration audit are found by comparing relevant performance evaluation indexes. This paper first verifies the feasibility of experimental schemes by using the Titanic dataset, because it is also a binary-classification problem and contains both character and numeric features, which is very similar to the drug delivery data, which will enlighten the processing and feature extraction of drug delivery data. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the models proposed in this paper are validated through specific experimental schemes.

articleTitle: Aviation Surveillance Information Fusion Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, with the comprehensive development of economy and technology in our country, the air transportation industry has also ushered in a golden period of development. The air traffic volume increases year by year, and the air route traffic volume will increase, which will lead to the need to carry more aircraft on the limited channel, resulting in the congestion of the channel and the potential safety problems. In order to ensure that the aircraft can fly safely, it is necessary for traffic management personnel to maintain the order of the aircraft in the channel according to the aviation monitoring information. Therefore, the accuracy of aviation surveillance information is particularly important. As a traditional track fusion algorithm, the Kalman filtering has the problem of requiring accurate error estimation, insensitivity to noise, and long calculation time in the case of large data volume. In this paper, a method of air surveillance information fusion based on ensemble learning is proposed, which can predict and fuse multiple air surveillance sources, i.e. multiple radar surveillance information, so as to obtain more accurate position estimation of the monitored target and reduce the error caused by the accuracy of radar itself, geographical location and surrounding environment.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Paxos Mechanism Design Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, a large number of token-less blockchain system use Paxos algorithm to reach a consensus. Based on game theory, this paper finds that when Paxos algorithm runs, each node in system may produce a kind of selfish behavior. The selfish behavior will lead to a game, which is called the computing resource dilemma game in this paper. By analyzing the payoff matrix and establishing the utility function model, it is found that Pareto optimal Nash equilibrium in the game needs to meet certain security conditions. Otherwise, each node will choose an uncooperative strategy, which will eventually lead to the system stop working. By solving the perfect Nash equilibrium solution of the subgame in the game, the security conditions for achieving the purpose(each node adheres to the cooperative strategy) of Paxos mechanism design are obtained. And the effectiveness of the security conditions is proved by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Power Wireless Network Quality Evaluation Method Based on Multi-dimensional Index
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The comprehensive evaluation of power wireless network quality is an important means to find out the short board of wireless network service, optimize the service ability of wireless network and improve the service level of power service. In this paper, from the point of view of security, accessibility and reliability of power wireless network, a comprehensive evaluation scheme is established in order to reflect the service quality of power grid reasonably and accurately. The density-based fuzzy clustering method is proposed to obtain the central index, and the grey relational analysis method based on entropy weight is used to remove the redundant non-central index in the evaluation scheme to overcome the lack of expert experience and ensure the accuracy of the index. Afterwards, the evaluation indicators are calculated through a combination of subjective and objective mixed weight to achieve a comprehensive assessment of wireless network bearing quality. The result of case study shows that the comprehensive evaluation scheme proposed in this paper can effectively and accurately reflect the quality of service of power wireless network.

articleTitle: A RRT*-based kinodynamic trajectory planning algorithm for Multirotor Micro Air Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents an online local trajectory planning algorithm for multirotor micro air vehicle(MAV) which applies the motion primitive generator proposed by Meuller et al. in RRT* algorithm to extend new nodes. The obtained results satisfy the dynamic constraints of multirotor MAV and avoid obstacles. Given initial state and final state, the motion primitive generator proposed by Meuller et al. generates a segment of polynomial trajectory to minimize the jerk of the trajectory. If initial state and final state are not feasible, the calculated motion primitive will not satisfy with the multirotor multirotor micro air vehicle dynamics. To resolve this problem, we use the numerical fitting method to obtain a mapping relation which gives the feasible range of the final state of the corresponding initial state. In the operation, such mapping can be called directly. Meanwhile, the trajectory is modified to decrease the velocity and acceleration of the end state of the whole trajectory as much as possible, so as to reduce the risk of colliding with obstacles not considered in the planning. Finally, we verified the effectiveness of the algorithm in the simulation environment.

articleTitle: Infrared Patch-tensor Model with A New Tensor Nuclear Norm for Small Target Detection in the Ground Background
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Accurate detection of infrared small target in complex scenes plays a vital role in many practical applications. In the infrared patch-tensor (IPT) model, small target detection is regarded as a convex optimization problem of tensor robust principal component analysis (TRPCA), which separates low tubal rank and sparse tensors. Tensor singular value thresholding is employd as the proximal operation of tensor nuclear norm to estimate the low-rank background components. Considering the defect that the local structural weights in the Reweighted IPT shrink excessively small targets, an effective local prior map is used to better mine target and background information. The local prior and sparse enhancement weight are combined to obtain the final adaptive weight. Alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is utilized to solve the model. Extensive experiments of infrared sequence images based on ground background prove that our algorithm has significant advantages in real-time and detection capability compared with state-of-the-arts.

articleTitle: Network Structure and Transmission Protocol for Transformer Collection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the transformers heavy using, efficient and reliable network and transportation protocol are becoming more and more important to collect energy data from the transformers. This paper proposed a new network topology for data collection from large amount resident transformers. This topology could provide flexible access service to user and improve network scalability. This paper also proposed a new data transferring protocol based on SNMP. The messages are classified into three types and encapsulated into trap packets. With an add-on acknowledgement mechanism, the new protocol could guarantee the delivery of important messages and merge other messages. It improved the utilization of the data collection network.

articleTitle: Borrower Credit Rating on Peer to Peer Loans
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide new insights into credit evaluation for P2P lending, a topic of great interest in the academic literature during the last several years. To this end, a BP neural network model of rating e-debtor credit is designed, which features constant adjustment of the weight between one neuron and another and gradually groping for the linkage through simulating & learning credit information data. Couple with the tangential technique, the proposed model, is resorted to conduct an empirical analysis of four samples. During 10 times of predications, almost all have reached projected criteria, except for one error occurring to two debtors. All four tested borrowers reach an average at 3.891, 7.934, 6.066 and 4.896 in the value of credit assessment and this is in agreement with reality. Hence, this modeling is of robustness, effectiveness and accuracy in evaluating an e-borrower's credit for P2P lending, not least of strong competency in processing nonlinear issues and adaptability. Therefore, BP neural network, has a prominent advantage in debtor credit assessment, which is characterized by nonlinearity, and should be applied to investigating similar issues in other areas.

articleTitle: A Decentralized Hybrid Method for Goal Assignment in Multi-Robot Exploration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Many multi-robot exploration (MRE) methods generate navigation goals so that the robots can observe unknown areas. The assignment of the goals to the robots greatly affects the exploration efficiency. This paper addresses the open-path multi-depot multiple traveling salesmen problem (OP-MmTSP) derived from multi-robot goal assignment (MGA) by presenting a decentralized method: the consensus-based decentralized discrete particle swarm optimization (CD-DPSO) algorithm. CDDPSO is a fully decentralized algorithm that assigns the computational tasks of a population-based metaheuristic algorithm to individual robots and enables them to collaborate. First, a discrete particle swarm optimization (DPSO) algorithm is proposed to resolve the OP-MmTSP. Second, the velocity update formula of DPSO is revised, inspired by the idea of the discrete time consensus algorithm that the particle swarms of all robots converge to the same solution via local communication. Finally, a variable neighborhood descent (VND) method consisting of two local search heuristics designed for min-max OP-MmTSP is adopted to improve the selected particles, which makes the CDDPSO a hybrid method that benefits from global search and local search. We applied two well-known auction-based task allocation algorithms to min-max OP-MmTSP and compared them to CDDPSO via numerical experiments. CDDPSO as a hybrid approach can usually find a better solution.

articleTitle: Improving Convolutional Network using K-max mechanism for Sentiment Analysis Tasks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a process in which natural language processing uses a computer to automatically comprehend specified topics from written or spoken language. In this paper, by comparing the experiments of recursive neural network and convolutional neural network on the English film review data set, and then adding attention mechanism, K-max mechanism, and highway network mechanism to the two models respectively, comparing the results of the models, we found The original convolutional neural network lags far behind the recursive neural network in the sentiment analysis task for English movie reviews, but it adds an optimized K-max mechanism and attention to the convolutional neural network and the recursive neural network respectively. After the mechanism, through analysis, the results show that among several optimization mechanisms, the K-max mechanism has a great optimization effect on the performance of the convolutional neural network in the field of English movie critic sentiment analysis tasks.

articleTitle: Job Satisfaction Recognition of Power Distribution Staff Based on Voice Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Safety production is important for power grid enterprises. It is not only related to enterprise factors, but also closely related to the individual behavior of employees. Among them, employee job satisfaction is significantly related to work safety. Therefore, to realize the timely perception of the psychological state and emotion of staff in the operation is of great importance to the information-based safe management. In this study, the research object is the staff involved in power distribution and operation in the power grid. Through the analysis of audio characteristics and job satisfaction, this research attempts to explore and establish its internal relationship, which provides a reference for predicting job satisfaction from the perspective of voice.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Mp3 Copyright Protection System for Mobile Terminals:Practicalissues
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of the Internet and mobile terminals, more and more pirate digital music resources are easily disseminated online. To prevent the illegal copies propagating among mobile devices and protect the right of content providers. In this paper, we designed a practical real-time mp3 Copyright Protection System(MCPS) for mobile terminals which is based on Client/Server model and contains three parts: security channel, server and client. In particular, we established a secure channel based on SSL(Secure Sockets Layer) protocol, defined an identity authentication procedure between the server and the client. In the server, we designed RC4 based encryption algorithm for frame header, and chaotic based watermarking algorithms for frame body, respectively. In the client, we designed a novel mp3 streamd ecoder, where, for each frame, frame header is decrypted, and the embedded information is extracted and compared with its IMEI to decide whether to decode or not. The practical experiments show that the system can effectively protect copyright for digital_music and is of great.

articleTitle: A Generative Model for Zero-Shot Learning via Wasserstein Auto-encoder
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Zero-shot learning aims to use the labeled instances to train the model, and then classifies the instances that belong to a class without labeled instances. However, the training instances and test instances are disjoint. Thus, the description of the classes (e.g. text description or class attribute information) is to establish a connection between the training set and the test set to make the model effective. Since real world image annotation requires a lot of manpower and material resources, this setting is very important in the real world. Zero-shot learning can effectively solve the problem of image annotation. Most of the previous methods explored the mapping between visual space and semantic space. Some recent generative methods attempt to generate image features of unseen classes based on auxiliary information, and have achieved good performances. In this paper, we propose to use Wasserstein Auto-encoder (WAE) as a generative model to establish data distribution. Then the generated samples from the generative model are used to classify unseen classes. We test our model on four benchmark datasets including CUB, SUN, AWA2 and aPY, the results of which demonstrate the effectiveness of our model.

articleTitle: Study on the Mode and Mechanism of the Big Data Opening about China's Government
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the era of big data, on the one hand, the opening of government big data can bring development opportunities for government governance, scientific research, social development, on the other hand, it also makes the protection of state secrets and personal privacy face great challenges. This paper first defines the scope of China's government's big data opening, then studies the current situation of foreign government's big data opening, then analyzes the current situation and challenges of China's government's big data opening, and finally proposes a method of mode and mechanism of China's government's big data opening, providing a reference for the implementation of China's big data opening policy.

articleTitle: Automatic adjustment system for space position and attitude of complex structural parts
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the assembly process of large-scale scientific test equipment, there are many difficulties in adjusting the space position and attitude of complex structural parts. The traditional method of adjusting the attitude manually is not only inefficient, but also has low positioning accuracy. This paper presents an automatic attitude adjustment system based on a Stewart 6-DOF parallel robot and coordinate measurement of laser tracker. Firstly, the structure and control strategy of the six degree of freedom motion platform are introduced, then the kinematic relationship between the position and attitude of the six degree of freedom motion platform and the displacement of each electric cylinder is analyzed. Secondly, the change matrix of the reference coordinate system, the static coordinate system and the moving coordinate system is established by using the local matrix, and the displacement and attitude of the adjustment mechanism is obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the system is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: TTP/C Data Bus Controller State Management Test
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper discusses the Time Triggered Protocol Data Bus architecture and application characteristics. By analyzing the state behavior and state transition conditions of the time-triggered bus state management mechanism., the class state machine model is established. Design a set of test sequences and expected validation data that meet the complete sequence coverage criteria. Carry out test case interpolation., write test driver script., run tested software., generate test report.

articleTitle: Research on DPFC Capacity and Parameter Design Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a DPFC capacity and inductance capacitance parameter design method is proposed. Firstly, DPFC power flow control range is determined according to relevant project demonstration to design the capacity of series side device. Secondly, according to the relevant regulations to determine the 3rd harmonic range, and design the parallel side capacity; Then the inductance and direct current capacity of the series and parallel filter are designed from the requirements of filtering and voltage stabilization. Finally, a simulation system containing DPFC electromagnetic transient model is built on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. The simulation results show that DPFC can quickly and effectively regulate the power flow of the system, maintain the stability of capacitor voltage, and the capacity utilization rate can reach more than 70%.

articleTitle: Research of UAV Location Control System Based on SINS, GPS and Optical Flow
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With combination of SINS and GPS, the precision and reliability of UAV navigation can be improved. Because of disadvantages of signals lost and disturbed easily, the application of SINS/GPS system has many boundedness in UAV navigation system. In order to develop the superiorities of SINS/GPS system, the paper put forward a method of location theory based on SINS, GPS, and optical flow in UAV navigation. By measuring the altitude and speed of UAV with optical flow, the two dimension optical flow messages are data fused with SINS by extended Kalman filter(EKF), the location, speed and gesture can be gotten in real time. With the results of inner experiments, it shows that the scheme can reduce the errors of location, speed and gesture of navigation, and the precision of location has been improved much.

articleTitle: Physical Model of FS-IGBT Considering Dynamic Avalanche Electrical Characteristics and Analysis of Chip Non-uniform Stress
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Dynamic avalanche is the extreme operating condition of IGBT, and it has unique electrical characteristics in the switching off transient. In order to accurately characterize the turn off characteristics of IGBT, this paper proposes an improved method of traditional IGBT turn off physical model for dynamic avalanche phenomenon based on the physical mechanism of dynamic avalanche phenomenon and the multiplier effect after dynamic avalanche formation. Finally, according to the physical model, the uneven distribution of stress on the chip surface is analyzed, which provides the basis for IGBT model establishment and reliability analysis.

articleTitle: Study of convolutional neural network based on fusion residual mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, due to the rapid development of computer technology, the calculate ability has been continuously improved. The depth of the deep convolutional neural network is getting larger and larger, and the performance of the model can also be improved. However, beyond a certain range, the training of the network model is prone to gradient explosion or vanishing. This article starts from the design of the residual mechanism, integrates with the traditional Vgg-16 network model, transfers image information from multiple aspects, obtains richer input features, “reduces” the depth of the network, and controls each network parameter operation effectively, suppress the occurrence of gradient explosion and vanishing, and improve the accuracy of picture classification. Experimental results show that the model proposed in this paper improves the accuracy of the network classification by 5.8% compared with that before the improvement.

articleTitle: Bionic robot based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The design of the bionic robot based on the Internet of things mainly includes two parts: wearable somatosensory device and robot. Wearable somatosensic devices mainly realize attitude acquisition through main control chip, MPU6050 attitude sensor and other hardware, and the attitude data collected is processed by kalman filter optimized by particle swarm optimization algorithm. The processed data is sent to the robot terminal through the wireless module, and the motion control of the robot is realized through the servo motor. Through this way to achieve the control of the robot. The robot is simple to operate, stable to run, low cost and has high application value.

articleTitle: Optimization Design Method of Impulse Current Generation Using MATLAB/SIMULINK
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The impulse current generator is widely used in the electrical power system, and the design method of the impulse current generator is mainly based on the classical theory. In view of this, this paper proposes new method of optimum design for the impulse current generator based on the MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation technology and the PSO intelligence optimization algorithm. This method can quickly and accurately determine the impulse current generator capacitance value C, the resistance value R, inductance RL and the initial DC voltage U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> according to the front time T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>, wave tail time T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>, peak current I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> and the time of current reaches maximum time. PSO-Simulink optimization design method is fit to the design of the linear and the nonlinear impulse current generator, however, the solution of the traditional analytical method is complicated and does not apply to limitation of nonlinear resistance. The research results of this paper have the certain reference value for the design and operation of the impulse current generator.

articleTitle: Research on multimedia Video Synthesis based on color segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Nowadays, the rapid development of film, television, animation and other multimedia industries requires more efficient video processing. Under the dual pressure of cost and time limitation, higher requirements are put forward for rapid video synthesis. Combining the commonly used RGB color space and HSV color space, a fast image segmentation method is proposed. Firstly, a Mask is calculated by using the threshold segmentation method. In order to reduce the influence of black on the final result, inrange used the second Mask to make the composition. The final result is multiplied by the original image, and the effect of black on threshold segmentation is effectively eliminated on the premise of not reducing efficiency and image quality, so as to achieve the most ideal effect. Compared with the previous real-time image segmentation processing, this method has been greatly improved in the degree of code simplicity, operation efficiency and cost. In the aspect of color extraction, as it is completed in the RGB color space domain, there is almost no color missing or redundant. The real-time segmentation and splicing of images can meet the basic needs of film and television shooting and greatly improve its efficiency.

articleTitle: Survey of image segmentation methods based on clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development and application of clustering algorithms, the problem of image segmentation has attracted more and more scholars and industry attention. This paper studies the clustering-based image segmentation method, summarizes the basic idea, and divides it into two categories, namely partition method and agglomeration method. The typical algorithms Kmeans algorithm, CLARANS algorithm, mean shift algorithm and DBSCAN algorithm of these two methods are introduced in detail. The advantages and limitations of these four methods are analyzed. Finally, it points out the future research trend of clustering algorithms and gives conclusions.

articleTitle: Commercial Vehicle Route Planning Design Based on Partition Coding Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The problem of vehicle path planning has been deeply studied in the fields of logistics and transportation for its broad application prospects. The correct planning of commercial vehicle routes will help reduce delivery time and logistics costs. Based on the example of commercial transport vehicles delivering goods, this paper establishes the Manhattan distance matrix between stations and obtains the overall optimization model. The genetic algorithm is the basic method for solving the vehicle routing model, which is used to calculate the integer-coded path sequence. Introduce roulette wheel selection, establish an adaptive algorithm to simplify the calculation process, and get the optimal transportation plan. The partition coding algorithm is used to solve the multiple traveling salesman problem, using the constraint function of the penalty factor to minimize the transportation cost, which has some reference value for the logistics transportation decision of the transportation company to reduce the cost.

articleTitle: Design and application of national reserved cultivated land resources investigation and evaluation database management system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The investigation and evaluation data of reserved cultivated land resources are of great significance to the research and policy-making about cultivated land protection, it is necessary to establish stable and efficient information systems to manage and use the massive data. To this end, this article adopt a hybrid storage strategy, uses relational database, non-relational database and file database to establish the national investigation and evaluation database of reserved cultivated land resources. Automatic and parallel database building technology, spatial big data calculation technology and vector data dynamic rendering technology are researched on, which has solved the technical bottleneck of large-scale spatial data storage, management and visualization. On this basis, developed the database management system, it has been applied in the government administration of cultivated land resources in China and exerts positive results.

articleTitle: Topological Public-Key Cryptography Based On Graph Image-Labellings For Information Security
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the field of information security, there are many public-key cryptographies, such as the RSA algorithm, EIGamal cryptography, Rabin algorithm and so on, these encryption algorithms are based on difficult algebraic problems. We propose a new encryption algorithm from the perspective of topology, which combine topological structures of graphs with matching-type image-labellings to generate public and private keys, and the new algorithm is based on the difficulty of judging the graph isomorphism problem. We construct two types of leaf self-similar trees, and our large-scale passwords can be generated on this basis, in addition, leaf self-similar tree increases the length and difficulty of the passwords for resisting the attack of supercomputers and quantum computers.

articleTitle: Low Inter-Reference Recency Set Replacement Policy in Named Data Networking
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Information-Centric Network (ICN) is a promising network architecture with content name-based routing and in-network caching as its main features. The characteristics of ICN are very suitable for future Internet with frequent information interaction. The performance of ICN is highly related to in-network caching, therefore, selecting a lightweight and efficient cache replacement policy is of vital importance in ICN. In this paper, we implement LIRS algorithm as a new cache replacement policy in Named Data Networking (NDN), one of the most mature ICN architectures. In ndnSIM, we simulate and compare the replacement policies of LIRS, LRU and FIFO based on different cache size, number of contents and Zipf parameters. Simulation results show that LIRS policy greatly improves the cache hit rate within O(1) time complexity and outperforms LRU policy and FIFO policy under different experiment settings.

articleTitle: Research on Ground Fault Line Selection Method Based on Zero Sequence Admittance
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a small current ground fault line selection system model is established under Matlab/Simulink environment. By setting the line parameters and simulation parameters, the fault simulation of the neutral point through the arc suppression coil grounding mode is completed. The characteristics of the single-phase grounding fault of the neutral point through the arc suppression coil are analyzed, and the zero-sequence voltage and zero-sequence current simulation waveform diagrams of the non-fault line and the fault line are given. The principle of line selection by zero-sequence admittance method is analyzed, a simulation model is built, and line selection is simulated, and the correctness of the method is verified.

Author Keywords: neutral point through arc suppression coil

articleTitle: A Study of Evaluation Methods of WEB Security Threats Based on Multi-stage Attack
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Web application services have gradually become an important support of Internet services, but are also facing increasingly serious security problems. It is extremely necessary to evaluate the security of Web application services to deal with attacks against them effectively. In this paper, in view of the characteristics of the current attack of Web application services, a Web security analysis model based on the kill chain is established, and the possible attacks against Web application services are analyzed in depth from the perspective of the kill chain. Then, the security of Web application services is evaluated in a quantitative manner. In this way, it can make up the defects of insufficient inspection by the existing security vulnerability model and the security specification of the tracking of Web application services, so as to realize the objective and scientific evaluation of the security state of Web application services.

articleTitle: Optimization of Sitting and Sizing of Microgrid in Distributed Generation Considering Reliability Costs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To reasonably optimize entrance location and capacity of microgrid so as to improve the reliability and economy is a vital target for allocation of microgrid in distribution system. Taking into the influence of outage costs into account, an optimization model of sitting and sizing of microgrid is established with an objective of the sum of investments, operation & maintenance costs, fuel costs, environment costs and outage costs. In order to considerate the impacts of entrance location of microgrid, access point and capacity of microsource on outage costs of distribution system, the outage costs are calculated by a reliability evaluation method for distribution system with microgrid. A case study is carried out based on RBTS-BUS 6. Using the genetic algorithm to solve this optimization model of sitting and sizing of microgrid, the results demonstrated that this model proposed can obtain the optimal scheme of sitting and sizing of microgrid to enhance the reliability and reduce the total costs.

articleTitle: A method for analyzing abnormality of automobile sunroof manufacturing process by using Bayesian method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the automotive sunroof manufacturing industry, due to factors such as people, machines, materials, manufacturing methods, measurement methods, environmental impacts, etc., many factors affect the quality of the final product, so the traditional control chart diagnosis and analysis is very difficult, in response to this situation, a kind of Abnormal diagnostic method for manufacturing process using Bayesian network. Based on the prior knowledge of process anomaly diagnosis and the abnormal features that need to be diagnosed, a Bayesian network-based manufacturing process anomaly diagnosis model is constructed.

articleTitle: Car handle character recognition algorithm based on circular projection and SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Character recognition is vital to character quality inspection on the surface of car handles. In order to solve the problem of characters with unfixed scales, rotation, and gray changes, we propose a car handle character recognition algorithm based on support vector machine and circular projection. Firstly, the algorithm binarizes car handle character image to eliminate the influence of grayscale changes. Secondly, according to the principle of the circular projection matching algorithm, equidistant circles are applied to extract the feature about the number of pixels within the minimum circumscribed circle of the character. Finally, a new character feature similarity measure function is introduced and combined with support vector machines to recognize the car handle characters. After being tested, the handle recognition characters with arbitrary rotation angles and scale changes in the range between 1 to 1.5 times, the algorithm recognition accuracy reached 98%.

articleTitle: Large-scale Simulated Dataset for Aerial Image Deblurring based on DOTA Dataset
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the vibration of the aerial imaging platform or the interference of atmospheric transmission, aerial images may be blurred and the image quality may be affected. However, the current traditional image deblurring algorithms are limited in processing capabilities and difficult to solve complex blur problems. Although deep learning methods provide inspirations for aerial image deblurring, large-scale dataset is needed to facilitate the training of deep networks. In this paper, a deblurring dataset generation method for aerial images is designed based on the DOTA dataset, which considers multiple degrading factors and efficiently generates a large number of simulated blurred images. The proposed method can handle the lack of training data and help to recover blur aerial images.

articleTitle: Design of Three-phase High Power Factor Correction Rectifier in Space AC-DC Energy System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Considering high power and high power factor of space AC-DC energy system, the VIENNA rectification is proposed. The structure of the topology suit for high-power occasions. The operating principles of proposed converter are described and the optimal parameter design of the input inductance and output capacitance parameters are carried out as well. Matlab Simulink is used to simulate the proposed topology, and the simulation results are analyzed. The simulation results demonstrated that the design of the proposed rectifier is able to complete high power factor and dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Affinity Propagation Clustering Algorithm Based on QPSO
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
