abstract: The affinity propagation algorithm is a distance-based clustering algorithm, which has the advantages of fast clustering speed, high accuracy, and no need to specify the number of clusters. The quantum particles swarm optimization algorithm has powerful parameter optimization capabilities. In this paper, we use the quantum particles swarm optimization algorithm, named QPSO-SAP, to optimize the bias parameters. Experiments show that the improved AP algorithm improves the clustering performance significantly on complex structured data sets.

articleTitle: Research on Online Monitoring of Energy Consumption of Rotary Kiln for Cement Clinker Formation Heat
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For the heat balance and thermal efficiency calculation of the cement rotary kiln firing system, the heat of cement clinker formation plays an important role in energy consumption. In the detailed energy consumption analysis of the cement firing system, the heat of clinker formation has different energy distributions in different production processes of the cement firing system. Aiming at the problem that the energy consumed by the clinker forming thermal rotary kiln cannot be monitored in real time, this paper proposes an online monitoring study based on least squares support vector machine. Through analysis and research, the input variables such as kiln head cover temperature are used, and the least squares support vector machine model is used for data training to obtain the energy value of energy consumption of clinker forming thermal rotary kiln. The results show that the energy consumption model of thermal rotary kiln based on least squares support vector machine for clinker formation can realize real-time monitoring of rotary kiln energy consumption. It is of great significance for the analysis of energy consumption of cement rotary kiln.

articleTitle: UAV remote sensing positioning algorithm based on image registration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the environment where GPS cannot be used to obtain remote sensing image, due to the limited resolution of the camera, the contour information of remote sensing image can not get its detailed texture features; the detailed texture information can be obtained by close shooting, but the location of the area contained in the current remote sensing image can not be determined. In this case, the image-based method is proposed UAV remote sensing positioning algorithm based on image registration. UAVs are small in size, easy to operate and cheap in price, Therefore, the UAV is used to obtain the remote sensing image, the input reference remote sensing image is cross segmented, and the segmented area is photographed to obtain the remote sensing image. The remote sensing image obtained and the initial input image are registered and stitched to obtain the reference image with detailed features, and the position of the UAV shooting the registration image can be deduced Navigate to the next step.

articleTitle: Research on Target Background Fusion Evaluation Method Based on Feature Parameter Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional background fusion evaluation method has different standards and strong subjectivity, the photoelectric reconnaissance equipment is used to obtain the disguised reconnaissance image of the target. The required characteristic parameters are extracted. The integration evaluation index system is constructed. And the target background fusion evaluation model based on feature parameter analysis is established. Taking the camouflage net as the research object, the example analysis is carried out. The rationality and effectiveness of the target background fusion evaluation method based on feature parameter analysis are verified by the experimental results. It provides a research idea for the evaluation of target camouflage effects.

articleTitle: Analysis of Assistant Reactive Shielding Coil for Electric Vehicle Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To realize electromagnetic safety of wireless power transmission (WPT) system for electric vehicle (EV), the shielding methods should be analyzed. This paper proposes a method of using assistant reactive shielding coils to cancel the electromagnetic field (EMF) outside the working area of WPT system. By tuning compensation capacitance of shielding coil automatically, we design 3 cases with different location and shape of coils to achieve reactive shielding. By comparison and simulation, placing ring shielding coils above receiving (Rx) pad and under transmitting (Tx) pad is the best way to suppress EMF of WPT system's non-working area. The shielding coils' radius is slightly bigger than coupling coils' outer radius. This paper also provides a new method to realize WPT shielding system's automatic adjustment for resonance. Besides, assistant reactive shielding coils' cost is lower than traditional aluminum plate.

articleTitle: Maintenance technology of substation source end based on IEC61850
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The source maintenance of data is the basis of the integrated construction and standardized operation of power automation system, and it is an important way to avoid repeated data transmission and improve the integration of automation system. In view of the current situation that the information demand of dispatching section and substation end is not equal, this paper decomposes the SCD file of substation, removes the irrelevant data of dispatching end, reconstructs the SCD file of main station and substation, and constructs the multi service unified data model of the whole station at the plant and station end. In order to improve the operability of source end maintenance, this paper adopts the file transmission and dynamic number based on IEC61850 The data set function realizes the key file transfer, subscription and publishing process, greatly reduces the intermediate mapping and maintenance process, and improves the source side maintenance stability and efficiency. The technology shown in this paper has been put into engineering operation in Guangdong power grid company, and the effect is good in the trial operation stage, so as to improve the efficiency of joint commissioning of infrastructure stations.

articleTitle: Design and application on Adaptive Particle Filtering for Integrated Train Positioning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of system model error and non-Gaussian noise interference caused by the complex train environment, a new adaptive filter is proposed for integrated train positioning, which is based on particle filter. It uses the IGG method to construct an equivalent weight function and introduces an adaptive factor to optimize the importance density function. The sensitivity of the algorithm to measuring environmental interference is reduced. The proposed AUPF algorithm is applied to the train integrated positioning system for simulation. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate that the performance of the proposed algorithm is superior to the standard UKF and UPF under the interference of non-Gaussian noise, leading to reduced positioning error.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism Design and Gesture Recognition Application of High Biomimetic Anthropomorphic Robotic Hand
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Since traditional dexterous hand has high cost, low degree of freedom, complicated control, our research benefits from human hand physiological structure, designs and prototypes a highly biomimetic anthropomorphic robotic hand, mimics the salient features of the human hand. We believe that the biomechanics of human hand is an essential component of the hand dexterity and can be replicated with highly biomimetic design. To this end, we first analyze human hand from engineering point of view, replicate the important biomechanical features with conventional mechanical design. Then, we reinterpret the essential biomechanical advantages of the human hand from roboticist's perspective and design a biomimetic robotic hand that closely mimics its human counterpart with artificial joint capsules, crocheted ligaments and tendons, laser-cut extensor hood, and elastic pulley mechanisms. To this end, we identify the workspaces of the fingertip by trajectory experiment, apply the robotic hand in gesture recognition experiment, which collecting the EMG signal through the MYO Armband and controlling the robotic hand to observe the performance of the biomimetic robotic hand. The experiment demonstrate that our design can be tele-operated to grasp and manipulate daily objects.

articleTitle: Speech Major Depression Detection Based on Adaboost-ELM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Depression patients have become the primary sub-health population in the world, the symptoms of depression distribution and disease analysis in the world are among the forefront of research projects, this paper using Boost Ada integrated framework, this paper presents an integrated detection model of Ada Boost classifier based on Ada Boost-ELM, which can improve the accuracy of classifier by adding weights to the base classifier. The Adaboost-ELM framework uses random numbers as the number of meta-samples of dictionary atoms. In order to enhance the heterogeneity of the integrated detection system, a random dynamic integrated weighted classification model is constructed by building multiple individual difference base classifiers. Through the Algorithm of speech recognition of major depression, detection of the specific conditions and classification of depression.

articleTitle: Research of Power Consumers Behavior Using Fuzzy C-means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To solve the problem that power enterprises make different power service strategies for users. The Fuzzy C-means (FCM) algorithm is used to cluster the monthly power consumption data in a certain area, the clustering results in 3 different months, the same clustering center and the monthly power consumption load curve are calculated. Based on the results of the algorithm, the reliability of the algorithm is evaluated. The clustering center obtained in a certain month is input into an algorithm to evaluate the fitness. According to the cluster analysis, there are some characteristics of the user's power load in September, and some fluctuations in the power grid. Power enterprises can formulate corresponding power service strategies for different power users to reduce grid fluctuations and improve power efficiency.

articleTitle: A Method of Verification in Chisel Based Deep Learning Accelerator Design
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Chisel is a new generation of hardware construction language (HCL) for agile development. More and more developers have developed their project in agile design. At the same time, a considerable part of Verilog-based design has also been released in agile design versions. However, there is no comprehensive verification flow for Chisel based design. Due to the difficulties of verification in Chisel based design, it is a tough task to attach Chisel based design on Verilog based design. We purpose a feasible verification flow in chisel-based deep learning accelerator (DLA) design, which is composed by performance equivalence check at module-level and function equivalence check at pin-level. Compared to Universe Verification Method in RTL level codes that cost considerable time and funds, this verification flow improves the verification efficiency and reduce the difficulty of debug.

articleTitle: An Efficient Software Faults Localization Method based on Program Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Spectrum-based Software Fault Localization (SBFL) method has been proved to be effective. The SBFL mainly analyzes the execution information of the test case set on each program entity and counts the suspiciousness value of each program entity through the suspiciousness formula. Different measurement methods of program entities have a significant influence on the accuracy of software faults localization because the effectiveness of the SBFL method depends on the suspiciousness calculation formula used. This paper proposes a new suspiciousness formula, fully considered the coverage information of different dimensions of the program spectrum. The suspiciousness formula can be widely used in a variety of faults localization methods extended on the SBFL method. The experimental results show that this method has advantages in effectiveness and efficiency of faults localization.

articleTitle: Vocal Melody Extraction using Attention U-net and Voice Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The melody extraction of polyphonic music is always an important research topic. Most melody extraction algorithms are based on computing a saliency function of pitch candidates or separating the melody source from the mixture. With the popularity of deep learning, data-driven methods based on deep neural networks, are gaining more and more attentions in the research of melody extraction. In this paper, our data-driven approach based on deep learning to treat melody extraction as a pixel-wise multi-task classification problem in image processing. The proposed model is composed of the advanced semantic segmentation Attention U-net that predicts the pitch salience map of the singing melody and voice detection model that estimate a voice activity of the polyphonic music and use a Softmax and an Argmax layer to get the final melody estimation. Experiments show that the proposed method can achieve better experimental results with small training dataset.

articleTitle: Modeling of boiler efficiency and NOx emission based on asymmetric PSO-BP
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the case of modern multiple power generation modes parallel, thermal power often needs to cooperate with new energy power generation for peak shaving operation, which leads to frequent load changes in thermal power plants, and it is necessary to establish new boiler models quickly and accurately. In this paper, an asymmetric PSO-BP neural network modeling method is proposed to solve this problem. According to the boiler mechanism principle, the non directly related network connection key is removed, and the network structure under different working conditions is unified, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is adopted to optimize it. Compared with the traditional neural network, the asymmetric PSO-BP neural network model has smaller prediction error and higher stability, which can improve the accuracy of boiler modeling, and lay a foundation for the boiler online modeling when the load changes rapidly.

articleTitle: Industrial Robot Control Based on Probablistic Network Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the autonomous trajectory control of industrial robots based on vision, based on the principle of PNN (Probabilistic Neural Network) classification recognition and NURBS (Non-Unifom Rational B Spline) trajectory planning, an autonomous trajectory control scheme for industrial robots using the result of PNN image recognition was Proposed. The visual system model of industrial robot was analyzed.the autonomous trajectory controller of industrial robot based on the recognition result of the visual system model was designed. The method of automatic generation of industrial robot NURBS trajectory using visual identification information was proposed. Finally, the closed loop system of autonomous trajectory control of industrial robot was designed with the industrial robot model.he simulation results show that the industrial robot control based on PNN image recognition can realize the smooth transformation of the control trajectory. The control scheme in this paper can realize stable and fast autonomous trajectory control of industrial robots based on vision.

articleTitle: Prediction of the growth trend of Weibo big v fans based on grey Markov model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As an important information output channel, blog is becoming more and more important in people's daily life. As one of the main channels for people to obtain information, Weibo has a large number of users and low publishing thresholds, which makes Weibo emerge a large number of key points. Opinion leader, that is, Weibo big V. Among them, the number of its fans greatly affects the opinion leader's right to speak on hot events. Therefore, this paper combines the gray prediction model and Markov model to establish a gray Markov model, which is used to study the growth trend of fans of opinion leaders in Weibo, and to provide a reference for information publishers in the communication process.

articleTitle: Historical development and current status of transverse beam feedback system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For the storage rings, there are always large numbers bunches and beam current in them, due to the resistive wall impedance and high order modes, strong beam instability will occur and cause beam current limit and beam loss. There are many methods to relieve this phenomenon. But the beam feedback system is almost the most effective way to suppress beam instability and large oscillations caused by beam injection among these methods. Therefore, it is an important guarantee for improving beam quality. This article will introduce the historical development and current status of the transverse beam feedback systems all over the world, the details of every part of transverse feedback system, such as signal detection unit, front-end electronics unit, signal processing electronics unit, and so on, and its recent new technologies and advances.

articleTitle: Multi-view Feature Fusion Recommendation Algorithm based on Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of representation learning, more and more external side-information like users `comment on item is introduced into the recommendation system to alleviate the problem of data sparseness. Recommendation algorithm based on multi-view learning considers those external side-information as independent views feature which is used to deal with data sparsity. However, these views are interdependent. By assuming that the view feature is independent, reducing the computational complexity, but resulting in poor recommendation performance. To solve this problem,this paper proposes a multi-view feature fusion recommendation algorithm based on representation learning,namely MVF. First, the algorithm uses an automatic encoder to extract the features of each view, and constructs second-order and third-order interactive features based on those features. Then, the singular value decomposition algorithm is used to compress the second-order interaction feature to extract the main interaction features, and the Tucker tensor decomposition algorithm is used to compress the third-order interaction feature to extract the main interaction features. After getting the main interaction feature,using the attention mechanism to fuse those features to get the representation of item. Considering that users have different preferences for different items, the attention mechanism is used to fuse user's items to obtain the user's preference model. Finally, Extensive experiments on real data sets from Amaza and compared with multiple baseline algorithms to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Detection Signal of Magnetostrictive Guided Wave at Elbow Pipe
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Magnetostrictive guided wave detection technology is widely used in pipeline detection because of its advantages of fast, convenient and efficient. However, its excitation and reception signals are mixed, and it has the characteristics of dispersion, multi-mode, non-stationary, etc., making guided wave signals the process of effective information extraction and signal processing is relatively complicated. In order to obtain useful guided wave information and improve the detection efficiency during the inspection process, an experimental platform for elbow pipe magnetostrictive guided wave inspection was built, and the wavelet transform were used to identify the guided wave defect detection signals. The results show that the wavelet transform can accurately identify the axial position of the defect and other information when processing the guided wave defect signal, and the time-frequency of the guided wave signal processed by the cmor0.6-1 wavelet basis function The analysis is the best. By drawing the guided wave modal identification analysis chart, we can clearly observe the moment when the mode conversion occurs, thus effectively identifying the non-defective signal and avoiding the misjudgment of the defect.

articleTitle: High sensitivity miniaturized remote control magnetic induction antenna design
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to realize remote control of underwater unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) and increase its concealment and retention, a small portable remote magnetic induction antenna with ultra-low frequency and high sensitivity is designed. Based on The Law of Electromagnetic induction, the equivalent model of magnetic induction antenna with parallel matching capacitance is established, the calculation formula of induction coil is derived in detail, and the preamplifier circuit of low noise integrated operational amplifier is designed and manufactured. Under the condition that the sensitivity, bandwidth, weight and volume of the induction coil are satisfied, the parameters of the induction coil are optimized by the multi-parameter joint optimization scheme, a set of design parameters of the magnetic induction antenna are determined, and the sensitivity of the magnetic induction antenna under the parameters is simulated. The results show that the sensitivity of the high-sensitivity miniaturized magnetic induction antenna meets the demand of ultra-low frequency underwater remote control signal reception.

articleTitle: BP Neural Network Noiceprint Recognition is Affected by Nasal Congestion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Voice is an inherent characteristic of humans, and the cost of acquiring equipment is low, and it is not restricted by location. Therefore, the speaker recognition technology that uses voice to identify the speaker has many unique advantages and is even irreplaceable in many scenarios. However, the development of speaker recognition technology still faces many difficulties and challenges. Affected by the vocal organs, when the nasal cavity is blocked, nasal congestion with distorted voiceprints will be emitted, which will affect the recognition rate of the speaker recognition system. Therefore, this article will study the difference between nasal congestion and normal sounds, and analyze the influence of nasal congestion on voiceprint recognition of an integrated and optimized BP neural network.

articleTitle: An Efficient Deduplication Scheme based on Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT)
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper proposes a secure data deduplication scheme which integrates fault tolerance, confidentiality and efficient key management. It adopts a secret sharing algorithm based on a Permutation Ordered Binary (POB) number system to decompose the data block into multiple random shares, and enhances data security by introducing the Proof of Ownership (PoW) concept. Moreover, our scheme applies a secret sharing algorithm based on the Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT) to divide the key into multiple random blocks and sends them to the corresponding Key Management Server (KMS) to minimize the key overhead. Experimental results show that our scheme overwhelms the other schemes in terms of function and efficiency.

articleTitle: Opinion Leader Identification and Reliability Tracking Based on Optimal Synthesis in the Social Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the simplified superposition problem during the opinion leader identification process and it is difficult to form a system between identification and evaluation, this paper researches the opinion leader identification and reliability tracking method based on optimal synthesis. We propose an improved index construction model, to measure overall node characteristics in the social network during two periods of event. Then we propose an optimal synthesis method to identify the opinion leader, and based on it, we construct opinion leader Reliability Index as an evaluation basis to realize the opinion leader reliability tracking. This method could effectively identify and evaluate opinion leaders. The experiment result shows that 77% of the opinion leaders satisfy the reliability tracking evaluation criteria, which effectively validates the beneficial effect of optimal synthesis and the feasibility of the identification-tracking system.

articleTitle: Application Research of Dynamic Static Reactive Power Compensation Technology in Ship Shore Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on the analysis and comparison of common reactive power compensation technologies in ports, this paper focuses on the key technologies and characteristics of dynamic static reactive power compensation, and makes application analysis and calculation examples for the dynamic static reactive power compensation technology of ship shore power system.

articleTitle: Construction and Effectiveness Analysis of the Effectiveness Evaluation Model of Formation Cooperative Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Cooperative formation detection is an important means of future maritime ship detection. Starting from the needs of future maritime formation coordinated operations, the concept and advantages of coordinated detection are analyzed, and the levels of different coordination modes are clarified. Based on the coordination strategy, a target threat degree model and an effectiveness evaluation model are established to solve the problem of choosing the better coordination strategy in the battlefield environment. The example simulation shows that the model and method can better realize the effectiveness evaluation of the collaborative strategy and meet the needs of strategy selection.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Rail Transit Supervision Management Information System Based on Mobile Office
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The development of mobile office and Internet provides the technical conditions for the information management of rail transit supervision. The paper presented the overall technical scheme of the system, designed the system function module, described the application of key technologies and summarize the development prospect of mobile supervision system. Which has a very good application value to improve lean management and core competence for supervision enterprises.

articleTitle: Improved Water Algorithm Based on K - Means Clustering Character Segmentation Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: When the adhesion of the adjacent two characters happen., if using traditional dripping algorithm., can make the water droplets in the vertical drop down two conglutination., character split phenomenon. If the character split character for character recognition operation., can't get the correct recognition as a result., when recognition accuracy is greatly reduced. Therefore., in order to solve this problem., based on the traditional algorithm on the basis of drop water., through the K - Means clustering method to determine the initial point of water., put forward the character segmentation method based on improved drop algorithm., reduce the error of the characters segmentation and segmentation.

articleTitle: Research on Standard Impact Index Model—Taking GB as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to use the advantages of other countries and standardization organizations to establish a standardization system that is more suitable for China's national conditions, and fully understand the advantages and disadvantages of various industries in our country. This paper will use the entropy weight-TOPSIS-grey correlation method of the national standard to compare 26 countries with analysis and evaluation of regional impact.

articleTitle: A SysML-based product configuration method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the increasing demand for product features and performance, the difficulty of the development for multi-disciplinary product systems is increasing as well. Document-based system engineering is difficult to meet the current requirements for development, and model-based system engineering is becoming the best choice. Although the models have become an important artifact of the current complex product development, and do help to improve the efficiency, and the information transmission efficiency is not high due to the complex process. Thus, a system model configuration method based on RFBS is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the system model graph is constructed based on SysML meta-model ontology. Then, a Requirement-Function-Behavior-Structure (RFBS) based system model configuration method is proposed. Finally, a case of The Automatic Climate Control Integrated System is given to show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Assessment of Students in College-School-Enterprise Cooperation Based on Entropy Bayesian Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper adopts the entropy weighting approach for calculating the weights of teaching attitude, teaching content, basic teaching skill, and teaching effect in student assessment of school-enterprise cooperation (SEC) majors and combines with the Bayesian approach for calculating the a posteriori probability of student assessment ratings of eight teachers of SEC majors in a college to reflect the student assessment ratings of different teachers. The outcomes exhibit that, in comparison to the traditional cumulative integration approach, the entropy-weighted Bayesian approach can better reflect the actual teacher-student rating. Finally, this paper summarizes the shortcomings of the entropy-weighted Bayesian approach in the calculation of the a posteriori probability and suggests the necessity of further refining the scores in data collection to solve this problem.

articleTitle: Design of a Hand-Holding laser cleaning control system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: According to the current safety problem of the handheld laser cleaning system, a control system is designed by real-time monitoring of specific state quantities and cooperating with the upper computer. The control system can achieve good human-computer interaction and ensure the safety of the operator. Avoid damage to laser internal devices. It can well solve the safety problem of high-power laser cleaning equipment in the process of use.

articleTitle: Graph Colorings Based On $n$-Dimension Digital-based Strings For Information Security
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A new type of total colorings is defined, we call them n-dimension total colorings such that the vertices and edges of graphs are colored with n-dimension digital-based strings a<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>a<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>...a<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>, and hold some restrictive conditions between the colors of vertices and edges of the graphs. We show that All trees admit 2-dimension proper total colorings by the ADDING-leaves algorithm. By trees admitting 2-dimension proper total colorings, we present tree-graphic lattices and 2-dimension Topcode-matrices for building topological cryptography in topological coding. Some mathematical problems for future research are proposed at the end of this article.

articleTitle: Multi-task achievement prediction model based on grade change trend
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Currently, the performance prediction model simply combines students' historical grade points, consumption and online data, and makes predictions all based on the same parameters, which causes a certain homogeneity and ignores the influence of the interactive characteristics between learning status and student social relations on performance prediction. It is impossible to make individualized predictions for each student. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-task logistic regression performance prediction model based on the trend of performance changes. This model defines the trend of course performance according to the semester and course categories. It is used to express the students' learning status for each type of course, and to construct the initial variable set together with historical grade points and student behavior data. According to the characteristics of the mutual influence of student friend relationships, multi-task learning (MTL) is introduced, and logistic regression is used as the benchmark model, It uses a weight clustering grouping method to group related tasks into a group, so that multiple students' task of predicting the performance of the students can jointly train the prediction model. Experiments show that the model can effectively perform personalized performance prediction, and the prediction accuracy is higher than traditional methods.

articleTitle: A high reliable low noise frequency synthesizer design
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A high reliable and low noise frequency synthesizer was designed and manufactured by 0.18um SiGe BiCMOS process. The innovation of this paper is to use HBT with better 1/f noise performance to replace MOS transistor to obtain better noise performance. The frequency synthesizer circuit is capable of producing 1.7GHz-2.3GHz RF output signal (one of the VCO output bands); The operating frequency of the frequency synthesizer is 800MHz-5GHz. The normalized phase noise of the frequency synthesizer reaches -230 dBc /Hz.

articleTitle: A New CCBFM/P4 RF Stealth Signal Waveform Design
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Chaotic signals show many advantages in the application of low probability of intercept (LPI) radar. In this paper, the compound chaotic-based frequency and P4 phase modulation (CCBFM/P4) signal is designed and its RF stealth performance is analyzed. First, the structure of compound chaotic mapping sequence is introduced and the characteristics of this sequence based on Bernoulli and tent chaotic maps are analyzed. Then, we put forward the structure of CCBFM/P4 signal which is based on compound chaotic-based frequency modulation and P4 code. The simulation results show that the CCBFM/P4 signal has better performance in range resolution, and the PSD of CCBFM/P4 signal is flatter. Also, the frequency distribution of CCBFM/P4 signal is disordered both under WVD and SPWD methods. All results show that CCBFM/P4 signal possesses better detect and RF stealth performance.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Smart Grid SOC Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Smart grid is the key infrastructure of the country, and its network security is an important link to ensure the national important infrastructure security. SOC as a secure operation mechanism for adaptive and continuous improvement of information security, it is practically significant to address the challenge to the network security of the smart grid. Based on the analysis of the technical characteristics and security of smart grid, and taking a grid enterprise smart grid as an example, we propose the design scheme and implementation plan of smart grid SOC platform. Experimental results show that the platform we designed can meet the performance requirements, it also meets the requirements of real-time storage of behavioral data and provides support for interactive analysis and batch analysis.

articleTitle: Grid Text Retrieval based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IOT) have developed rapidly in recent years, which produces a vast amount of data including the electronic text data and the distributed data etc. These massive data hide a wealth of useful information and knowledge, and analyze them on the needs of users and assess the effect of products has a great significance. Therefore, it is an urgent problem to propose an efficient method of grid text retrieval. As is known to all, deep learning models are the most effective way to deal with massive data. In our paper, we will use an effective deep learning model to retrieve the grid text. i.e., the Deep Boltzmann Machines model (DBMs). The DBMs model is an effective text clustering algorithm. In particular, DBMs integrate a special energy function and use a layer-by-layer pre-training phase, which can make model more effective. The design of deep structure also enables the DBMs to extract the good text representations. The experimental results show that the DBMs model gets the desirable effect in handling with an extract abstract concept and has a good performance in large scale grid text clustering.

articleTitle: Network Filtering Algorithm based on Large Scale URL Pattern String Matching Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the situation of mass URL examination and filtering in the power information network, this paper proposes a large-scale URL pattern string matching algorithm based on the Wu-Manber algorithm. The proposed algorithm improves the matching of the algorithm from the angle of reducing the hash conflict and reducing the number of accurate checksums. Match performance. Tests on real data sets show that the algorithm has lower memory consumption. The algorithm proposed in this paper improves the performance of large scale URL matching, and the detection method can be applied to many network filtering occasions.

articleTitle: Case Study of ICT Architectures for a Context-Aware System in Smart Energy Domain
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Nowadays, by the integration of the internet into many computational areas, smart energy automation and the reliable controlling system can be achieved by introducing the Internet of Things (IoT). As IoT becomes an active research area, different methods, and strategies from different points of view have been explored to promote the development and popularity of IoT. One trend is viewing IoT as Web of Things (WoT) where the open Web standards are supported for information sharing and device interpretation. This WoT vision enables a new way of narrowing the barrier between the virtual and physical worlds. This paper presents the result of a European project in demonstrating different ICT architectures for context information management. It uses some key enabling technologies of WoT to share the data from the smart energy system and end up with a hybrid ICT architecture. The demonstrated architectures can be further powered with any intelligent algorithms and applications to provide a fully digitalized environment.

articleTitle: Model for Data Access of Command Information System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems in the data access process of command information system, such as the low matching degree between using authority and command task, the imperfect mechanism of data exception handling, and the unsynchronized data updating of the whole network, this paper proposes a model for data access of command information system based on blockchain. The model uses blockchain to manage and supervise the use process of command information, so as to realize the response of information access application on demand, real-time discovery and processing of data exceptions, and synchronous update of data throughout the network. Through analysis and evaluation, it is proved that the model can provide reliable, safe and consistent data access for commanders in complex and harsh command environment.

articleTitle: The Flood Discharge Monitoring System based on Resource Virtual Mapping Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Mining is an important part of the national economy and has always played a pivotal role in the rapid development of the national economy. The safety of tailings dam is key factor for the mining operation, especially the flood discharge safety. As the development of the 5G technologies, it is possible to monitor the safety of tailings dam remotely and intelligently. The data collector for flood discharge culvert is designed to scan the panorama hazards. The resource mapping algorithm is proposed to solve the mass users and bulk data transmission. The problem of inter-cell interference in a 5G ultra-dense network environment is addressed, and a wireless virtual mapping algorithm to reduce inter-cell interference is proposed in this system. The results show that this system can help the mine staff to improve the tailings dam safety in daily supervision.

articleTitle: Multi-target Image Detection Using Pigeon-Inspired Optimization based Species Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Multi-target detection (MTD) has a wide range of applications in target recognition, visual tracking, and other fields. The task of MTD is to find the sub-image set with the highest matching degree using the template image set from the source image. Therefore, this problem can be mapped to a multi-modal optimization problem. This paper combines the modified pigeon-inspired optimization (PIO) and species-based mechanism to perform multi-template matching tasks. To enhance the performance of our proposed method, the PIO is modified as follows: (1) the fitness of the seed is chosen as the switch signal of the map and compass operator and landmark operator; (2) in landmark operator, the halve mechanism is removed and a perturbation factor is introduced to enhance the exploration and exploitation ability. The species-based mechanism is utilized to search for multiple extreme points in parallel with multiple subpopulations. In addition, an expel mechanism is proposed to avoid the unnecessary fitness evaluation around the detected optima. Simulation results demonstrate that our proposed method performs better in detection accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Coevolutionary Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm for Water Resources Problems and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the complex water resources allocation problem of Zhengzhou city to develop into a national central city, a multi-objective optimal allocation model of water resources based on coevolutionary particle swarm optimization (CPSO) was proposed. The objective is to maximize the social, economic and ecological benefits. The constraints include water supply, water demand, water supply capacity and reservoir. By inputting the water demand and available water supply situation of each calculation unit and department in Zhengzhou, the model calculates and outputs the water shortage ratio of nine districts in Zhengzhou in 2019, 2025 and 2035. The results show that the model can be applied to water resources allocation problems efficiently and provide help for water resources management.

articleTitle: Spinal Fracture Detection Based on Deformable Cascade Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of long CT reading cycles and manual misdiagnosis of spinal burst fracture, the paper proposes an algorithm Deformable Cascade Network(DCNet) for detecting spinal burst fracture grade. Based on Faster RCNN network structure, DCNet algorithm replaces the original VGG 16 by resnet50 with deformable residual module, it adds cascade detector module in the network detection part, thus enhancing the feature extraction ability and detection ability. Through experimental comparison tests, the optimized mean average precision (MAP) of DCNet is 92.8%, precision is 91.7%, recall is 95.7%, and the average detection speed can reach 47.6FPS. The DCNet algorithm proposed in this paper improves the efficiency and accuracy of CT diagnosis of spinal burst fracture, and provides an effective new method for computer-aided diagnosis of spinal burst fracture.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Wearable Temperature Sensors Based on Multi-scale Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Intelligent fault diagnosis is often used to improve the reliability, safety and stability of wearable sensors. In order to avoid the interference of expert experience to the fault diagnosis system, a multi-scale convolutional neural network model (MSCNN) is proposed. First, a novel MSCNN model is established to extract the deep features of the input data through convolution kernels of different sizes. Then, to improve the diagnostic efficiency of this method, a global average pooling layer is introduced to sub-sample the input features. Finally, the extracted sparse feature maps are input into the softmax classifier for fault classification. This method is applied to the diagnosis of wearable temperature sensor signals. The results show that this method has higher classification accuracy and faster efficiency than existing fault diagnosis methods such as artificial neural networks (ANN), traditional CNN, stackable automatic encoder (SAE) and support vector machines (SVM).

articleTitle: Circle Loss Based Metric Learning For Few-Shot Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Few-shot classification aims to identify new categories from only a handful of labeled examples and has drawn considerable attention in machine learning. An efficient and effective approach for solving few-shot classification has featured episodic training based metric learning which attempts to learn a task-generic embedding space on extremely large episodes, each with a small labeled support set and its corresponding query set. Distances between embeddings of examples from the query set and support set are then used as a notion of similarity to do classification. This paper first adds a margin between different classes to increase the inter-class distance in the embedding space(we call this method ML-FSC). Furthermore, considering that a similarity score that deviates far from the optimum should be emphasized, this paper introduces the circle loss into the episodic training based metric learning, which simply re-weights each similarity to highlight the less-optimized similarity scores, contributing to a more discriminative embedding learning(we call this method CL-FSC). We conduct comprehensive experiments to validate our method and we set new state-of-the-art performance on three popular few-shot classification benchmarks, namely omniglot, miniImageNet and tieredImageNet.

articleTitle: Studies on high frequency characteristics of sinusoidal terahertz slow wave structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a miniature sinusoidal slow wave structure is proposed for the development of vacuum electron terahertz radiation source. The 3D electromagnetic simulation is used to study and analyze its high frequency characteristics, and four main structural parameters are optimized. The simulation results show that the phase velocity of electromagnetic wave can be reduced by increasing the ripple depth, and the coupling impedance can be increased as well. The operating frequency is improved by reducing the length of periodical structure, and the phase velocity is reduced by increasing the width of cross section. The coupling impedance can be improved by reducing the height of electron channel. The proposed slow wave structure achieved the optimized characteristics at frequency of 300 GHz.

articleTitle: Research on energy management test of typical extended range hybrid electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to quantitatively test and analyze the off energy management and control technology of the hybrid electric vehicle, a new test analysis method is proposed. Through signal analysis and the arrangement of a small number of sensors, important signals such as the power of the extender and the battery current are obtained, the test analysis matrix is designed, and the energy management and control strategy of the whole vehicle is tested and analyzed. The test and analysis of energy management and control technology can be realized in a short time by the method verified by the real vehicle. The Nissan note E-power system is optimized through professional matching, and all energy source components are precisely coordinated and controlled, which is well adapted to various driving conditions, especially in the low and medium speed conditions, with excellent energy consumption performance.

articleTitle: Research on Local Consensus Algorithm Based on Wireless Sensor Network of Power Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the power monitoring system, it is necessary to carry out long-term continuous monitoring of the current and voltage of the monitored equipment, and the wind speed, temperature, humidity and other parameters in the monitoring environment, usually using wireless sensor networks as the communication method. Affected by factors such as power consumption, bandwidth, transmission distance, it is very important to select the appropriate data synchronization algorithm in the wireless sensor network. Inspired by the blockchain consensus algorithm, the local consensus algorithm proposed in this paper focuses on the analysis of the data synchronization mechanism between network nodes, which can reduce unnecessary data interaction between nodes and increase the reliability, real-time and adaptability of the network.

articleTitle: Design of Detection System for Mine DC Stabilized Power Supply Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Mine DC stabilized power supply is the basic component to realize AC/DC conversion or voltage grade conversion. Its safety index, performance parameters and product quality have an important impact on the safety, stability and reliability of the whole system. However, in the past, separate equipment was used for single-item testing of mine power supply. The testing process was discontinuous, the dynamic and instantaneous characteristics were difficult to grasp, the testing time was long, the efficiency was low, and it was difficult to ensure the accuracy and consistency of the testing results due to factors such as the level of testers. Therefore, in order to realize the automatic inspection and testing of mine power supply and improve the detection efficiency and accuracy, the detection system of mine DC stabilized power supply is developed. The hardware design of the system adopts unified packaging and electrical transformation. The system software adopts virtual instrument technology for modular and hierarchical design to improve the system development efficiency and the portability and maintainability of the software. The test results show that the system realizes automatic detection of mine power supply, the detection data is reliable, the conclusion is correct, and the detection efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Line Backup Protection Fixed Value Optimization of Multi-Infeed DC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Shandong power grid is a typical uhv ac/dc mixed power grid, is also a typical feed in HVDC system, in order to be complicated working condition, the shandong company by optimizing the way of backup protection setting to prevent refusing action, the main cause of multiple dc commutation failure in a row, causing more HVDC pole blocking collapse, leading to power grid in this paper, mainly aimed at distance zero sequence backup protection backup protection period of matching principle and matching principle to carry out the simulation analysis. Simulation results show that de where access will not bring communication relay protection backup segment with the new problems, from a backup using simplified setting principle, when a line of all the main protection loses, may cause the line fault line distance II at the next higher level and at the corresponding level line distance II action conditions at the same time, due to the delay, as possible match problem, the follow-up to carry out special study for this problem.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing Method of Non-Truck Operating Common Carrier under Cost-Core Multivariate Conditions
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Non-Truck Operating Common Carrier platform is a pioneering work in road transportation. However, there is no reasonable evaluation standard for the scientific pricing of freight routes, which has become an urgent problem to be solved for these platforms. This paper first evaluates the real data by combining the principal component analysis model and obtains the main factors affecting the price of the route, including transportation cost, platform transaction mode, the number of uncertain factors of tasks, drivers' preference/business scenario, the complexity of the execution process, transaction difficulty and renewal status. On the other hand, this paper presents a comprehensive evaluation model of principal components to evaluate the price in the historical transaction data of freight lines. Combined with the actual situation, this paper establishes a multiple regression model and solves it by using the least square method to obtain the mathematical relationship of route pricing. The results show that the research in this paper can effectively reduce the cost of transportation, improve the speed of transactions, and have a certain guiding role for the development of the Non-Truck Operating Common carrier industry.

articleTitle: Rotating Speed Adjusting System of Generator Based on PWM and FLC
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: to ensure the feeding quality of ground power supply car, the rotating speed of generator driven by diesel engine on the car should be constant. In generator rotating speed adjusting system, the voltage signal output by the tachometer device of diesel engine compared with the standard voltage corresponds to generator's settled rotating speed, the deviation is two-stage amplified to output a voltage signal. On one hand, the signal converted by PWM to a corresponding pulse width voltage wave to drive actuator to adjust diesel engine's oil supply quantity and rotating speed; on other hand, FLC can also output control voltage to add on actuator according to the signal. So, the dynamic state quality of the system is further improvement to enhance system's stability, thus, the generator's rotating speed keeps stable. On the base of finishing the design of the circuit of rotating speed adjusting system, the paper introduces the control project of combining PWM and FLC in generator rotating speed adjusting system, and acquires better control effect.

articleTitle: Research on Film Data Preprocessing and Visualization
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Data is the core of information, and good data quality is a prerequisite for many data analysis. Data cleaning is to increase the fault tolerance rate by correcting the error value of detected data. This paper aims to solve the problem of data set processing and visualization in the recommendation algorithm, so as to better apply in the field of recommendation algorithm. The recommendation algorithm and data sets Movielens and IMDB are analyzed theoretically. First, data set A was processed from data reading and movie score calculation; Again, the IMDB is processed in four steps to make it more suitable for the recommendation algorithm field; Finally, the plot function is used to visualize the key information. experiment shows: The data set sorted out by the above methods can effectively improve the quality and availability of data and provide relevant basis for better application in the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Data Transmission Security Architecture Design and Process
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of business, management companies are currently facing a series of problems and challenges in terms of resource allocation and task management. In terms of the technical route, this research will use cloud services to implement the public honesty system, and carry out secondary development and interface development on this basis, the architecture design and the formulation of the process are realized for various types, relying on the support of the knowledge base and case library, through the system intelligent configuration corresponding work instructions, safety work instructions, case references and other reference information to the existing work plan to provide managers Reference; managers can configure and adjust the work content by themselves through specific requirements to efficiently and flexibly adapt to the work content.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Substation Integrated Communication Simulation and Analysis Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The automation and remote control ability of intelligent substation is improved significantly by the characteristics of network-based information transmission mode and device application configuration file. However, the feature of high coupling between the equipment of the secondary system also makes the risk of overhaul and reconstruction increase greatly so that the reform of just one intelligent secondary equipment may affect the public equipment such as voltage and busbar protection, worse still, a series of security problems such as large scale blackouts will occur. This paper establishes an optimal isolation evaluation strategy system for secondary interval overhaul and reconstruction, proposes the fast, easy and safe isolation operation method and founds an integrated communication simulation and analysis platform system for target interval isolation strategy in the intelligent station. Consequently, we will provide strong technical support for safe and stable operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Systematic Analysis for Violent Fluctuations of Stock Price: A Case Study of Technological Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Stock price is usually regarded as an index reflecting the basic value of an enterprise, and its fluctuations is contributed by many factors. However, violent fluctuations of stock price may confuse people's value judgment and decision-making, especially for technology-based enterprises in era of new technological revolution. A systemic framework is demonstrated to explore the joint effect of multiple factors which trigger the abnormal fluctuation of stock price. One of Listed Companies on GEM of China is selected for case study based on the method of fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA). The result shows that technology & management is a slow variable in China, and the changes of Chinese stock market are mainly affected by policy and speculation, which is the main causes of stock price bubbles. Therefore, future research can be carried out to proving the servitude effect of technology & management on stock price.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Speech Recognition Based on Whale Algorithm Isolated Words
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Speech recognition is an internationally recognized and promising new technology. This paper studies the improved speech recognition based on whale algorithm isolated words. Firstly, the basic whale algorithm is introduced. U sing standard and improved whale algorithms, the BP neural network is optimized. Then the data are trained and learned respectively, and the recognition rate is compared. Finally the more suitable method for speech recognition of isolated words is determined. The self-built database experiments show that compared with the standard algorithm to optimize the BP neural network, the improved algorithm is helpful to improve the accuracy of speech recognition.

articleTitle: The weight analysis model of user experience elements and technical indicators in DEA method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Quality of Experience (QoE) plays an important role in 3d scenes and is of great significance to the future development of technology. Technical parameters are still a key factor influencing the Quality of Experience (QoE). In order to better explain the relationship between technical parameters and Quality of Experience (QoE). In this paper, Quality of Experience (QoE) is divided into three elements and implements a weight analysis model between user experience elements and technical indicators. In view of the above model, we put forward the overall efficiency analysis method based on DEA, and calculated the weights of all aspects. In this way, when determining the technical scheme of 3d video, by balancing important indicators and non-important indicators, one/several technical aspects can be improved pertinently and better video effect can be achieved with less cost.

articleTitle: Analysis of Anti-Guided Interference in Ground Wave Mode of Shortwave Frequency Hopping communication system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the current lack of quantitative analysis of anti-guided interference capability of short-wave frequency hopping system in ground wave propagation mode, based on the concept of interference ellipses, this paper mathematically deduces the communication quality and resistance of shortwave frequency hopping communication under the premise of guided interference. The factors of guided interference ability are analyzed. The positional relationship between the transceiver and the jammer, the frequency hopping rate, the directional antenna with different main lobe width of the transceiver, and the radiated power of the jammer are analyzed by the interference ellipse coverage and the error rate. The response of factors in communication confrontation, and the corresponding computer simulation verification is given.

articleTitle: An algorithm for vertex distinguishing total coloring of $K_{n}-E(K_{2,m})$ Graphs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Vertex distinguishing total coloring of graph G=(p, q) refers to the coloring of vertices and edges, so that any vertex coloring is different, adjacent edge coloring is different, vertex and its associated edge coloring are different, the coloring of vertex and its associated edge is different, and any two points u, v that are different from each other in G have C(U) ≠ C(V), where C(x) represents the set of colors of vertex x and edge associated with x under f. Then f is called vertex distinguishing total coloring of graph G, which is called VDTC coloring for short. We call ψ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vdtc</sub>(G) = min { k| there exists a k-VDTC of G}, and call ψ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vdtc</sub>(G) the vertex distinguishing total chromatic number of G. In this paper, we design an accurate algorithm for K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>-E(K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,m</sub>)(n ≥ 3,m ≥ 2) graphs. By using this algorithm, we can get the vertex distinguishing total coloring of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>-E(K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,m</sub>) graphs within finite vertexs. Through the analysis of the results, some theorems are summarized and proved, and further conjectures are given.

articleTitle: Hot Topic Detection Based on Image Intelligent Understanding and Comment Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Micro-blog has become the main distribution center of public opinion. Therefore, how to mine hot topics from microblog has become a hot topic. However, microblogs are mostly short texts and contain a large number of invalid information, which significantly increases the difficulty of hot topic detection. On the other hand, micro-blog includes text, pictures and comment information, which greatly enriches the diversity of information. Therefore, this paper proposed a new method, which applies deep learning to image understanding. Image content is interpreted as analyzable text semantic information combined with comments to enrich short text information. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method, and better experimental results are obtained compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Platform Design and Implementation for Railway Industry Research Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of relatively low efficiency in the process of railway industry research cooperation, we designed and developed the railway industry research cooperation platform. On the basis of the analysis of platform positioning and functional requirements, we designed the overall architecture, technical architecture and functional architecture of the platform. The platform takes the cooperation needs of the railway bureaus and the group company as the “traction”, and creates a smooth supply and demand docking channel through the establishment of information, shopping mall, project library, interaction and other modules, so as to turn the production research cooperation into spontaneous and active daily cooperation, and help users grasp hands, solve problems and share together. It meets the needs of the efficiency improvement of railway production research cooperation, and has certain feasibility and practicability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Operating Management Platform of Dispatching and Control Cloud Application based on Container Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of dispatching and control cloud platform, the existing virtual resource management mechanism has been unable to meet the requirements of rapid construction, agile delivery and convenient management of applications. The emergence of container technology provides a good solution. Combined with the Docker technology and the requirements of application lifecycle management, this paper proposes an operating management platform of dispatching and control cloud application based on container technology, introduces the overall architecture of the platform, designs and implements function modules including image management, application management and resource scheduling. With the platform designed in this paper, applications can realize the rapid construction, efficient deployment and convenient management, meet the requirements of flexible elastic expansion and directional scheduling, generally provide strong support for the development and use of the dispatching and control cloud platform.

articleTitle: Research on Equipment Damage Grade Evaluation Model Based on ISODATA Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of equipment battlefield damage assessment, an index system and quantitative method for equipment battlefield damage assessment are established. The basic principles of ISODATA fuzzy clustering are used to analyze and discuss the equipment battlefield damage assessment, which overcomes the identify difficult issues using previous fuzzy comprehensive evaluation weights and provides a basic foundation for effectively making equipment battlefield repair decisions. Finally, the rationality and reliability of the model were verified by an example analysis.

articleTitle: Design of virtual simulation system for marine electromechanical equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Absrtact-virtual scene roaming and interactive operation is an important basis of virtual reality simulation, which is convenient for students to freely access and roam in local and global scenes. With intelligent automatic roaming and path shortening algorithm control, it is convenient for users to reach the destination and target scene with the best and fastest path. The 3D picking effectiveness judgment function of interaction points is helpful for students in virtual reality In the scene of dynamic real-time manipulation of selected objects, real-time rendering of client-side dynamic display of operation results, better interactive immersion and efficient human-computer interaction. The emphasis of this paper is the manual automatic roaming mode under the path optimization algorithm and the behavior modeling algorithm of 3D picking validity judgment in virtual scene.

articleTitle: Research on Application of the PI Controller in APF Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Active Power Filter (APF) is a new type of power electronic equipment used to suppress harmonics and compensate reactive power dynamically. It can compensate the harmonics and reactive power components which vary in size and frequency in real time. This paper researches the parallel APF's control strategy, puts forward the PI controller structure based on the fuzzy control, designs principles and methods. Finally, it detects and analyzes the difference between the current spectrum before and after using this controller in the Active Power Filter. It is proved very necessary to the APF.

articleTitle: A CS-SemiUKF Based Algorithm on Trajectory Estimation in Boost Phase
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at improving the computational efficiency of the boost phase trajectory estimation algorithm based on the Current Statistic-Uncented Kalman Filtering (CS-UKF), a CS-SemiUKF based boost phase trajectory algorithm is proposed. According to the characteristics of the CS model, the Linear State Equation is used for state prediction and state covariance matrix prediction, and the Measurement Update phase is still achieved through the Sigma points nonlinear propagation. The simulation shows that, compared with the CS-UKF based boost phase trajectory algorithm, the proposed algorithm is rational and effective, the operation time is reduced by approximately 27% under the condition that the estimation error is equivalent.

articleTitle: Feature Quantization for Many-to-many Voice Conversion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, Voice Conversion (VC) has made great strides with the application of deep learning. Many works on many-to-many Voice Conversion task require to have parallel training data and multiple generative adversarial networks. One of the successful models for VC is the Star generative adversarial network (StarGAN-VC), which does not require parallel training data and can use a single generator and discriminator for all pairs of speakers domains. However, training a high quality StarGAN is not an easy task. Using a single generator and discriminator with mini-batch statistics to perform feature mapping will result in an insurmountable gap between the converted distribution and the real distribution. In this paper, we proposed a Feature Quantization model plugged into the discriminator of StarGAN-VC2, which can quantize the continuous feature into a discrete embedding space to solve the feature mapping problem and improve the quality of converted speech. Experiments show that our proposed model can improve the MCD scores of baseline methods which confirm the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Matching Network Focusing on the Relation between Samples
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Deep learning plays an important role in the field of artificial intelligence, but in most situation, deep learning requires a larger number of training samples to complete high-precision learning. Few-shot learning, which only uses a small dataset to learn different tasks, has been extensively researched. It can be summarized into three methods: metric learning, optimization-based and model-based. In this paper, we develop a novel method based on Matching Networks: focusing on the relation between samples. We have proposed a simple method based on the idea that we can aggregate intra-class samples and separate inter-class samples. Our experiments on the Omniglot dataset and miniImageNet dataset show that our method outperforms the baseline networks.

articleTitle: Sidelobe Coherency Recovery Technique of Interpulse Diversity based on Inverse Filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Transmitting the pulse-to-pulse agile waveforms will break up the sidelobe coherency of impulse responses, which makes the static clutter fail to be completely suppressed, and has a negative impact on radar detection.
