In this paper, inspired by inverse filtering, we propose an effective method for designing pulse-compression filters that recover the sidelobe coherency of the agile waveforms. By selecting an appropriate window function in the frequency-domain, the impulse responses can be all identical while achieving marked sidelobe level improvement. Furthermore, we analyse the echoes of targets with different speeds and point out the situation which would happen in modern radar application. Simulations are conducted to verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Malware Detection for Industrial Internet Based on GAN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This thesis focuses on the detection of malware in industrial Internet. The basic flow of the detection of malware contains feature extraction and sample identification. API graph can effectively represent the behavior information of malware. However, due to the high algorithm complexity of solving the problem of subgraph isomorphism, the efficiency of analysis based on graph structure feature is low. Due to the different scales of API graph of different malicious codes, the API graph needs to be normalized. Considering the difficulties of sample collection and manual marking, it is necessary to expand the number of malware samples in industrial Internet. This paper proposes a method that combines PageRank with TF-IDF to process the API graph. Besides, this paper proposes a method to construct the adversarial samples of malwares based on GAN.

articleTitle: Multiple Transmission Resonance Modes in Heterostructure Photonic Crystal
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, we exploit multiple transmission resonance modes in heterostructure photonic crystal using the transfer matrix method. The building blocks of the proposed structures are composed of periodic photonic crystals with period number <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pmb{n}$</tex>. By assembling the building blocks in proper order, we observe multiple transmission resonance modes in the spectrum of the heterostructure photonic crystal under the normal incidence condition. The amount of the multiple transmission resonance modes is adjustable by merely altering the period number <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pmb{N}$</tex> of the building blocks. Furthermore, we investigate the influence of the dielectric materials index on the transmission peaks. The proposed heterostructure structure is sensitive to the change of material index, which has a potential application as an index sensor in the field of bio-photonics. In short, this work is a promising candidate as an on-chip multichannel filter and a sensor for future optical communication design.

articleTitle: Fault feature selection method based on fuzzy preference relation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on the research of classical clustering algorithm, a sensitive feature selection method based on fuzzy preference relation is proposed in this paper. The method selects sensitive features by calculating fuzzy relation and sensitivity coefficient. The experimental results show that the proposed method reduces the feature dimension and simplifies the feature set. Combined with hierarchical clustering algorithm, it achieves high fault diagnosis accuracy.

articleTitle: The loop closure Detection Algorithm Based on Bag of Semantic Word For Robot Navigation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is mainly used to solve the problem of mobile robot navigation in an unknown environment. The loop closure detection is a key step in visual SLAM and plays an important role in building consistent maps and reducing pose cumulative errors. A new loop closure detection method based on the bag of semantic word (BOSW) is proposed in this paper, extracting semantic descriptors by using a neural network pre-trained on the scene recognition data set. Traditionally, the visual bag of word (BoW) model adopts the features such as ORB and SURF which is easily affected by the environment. With advantages of better ability to deal with changes in lighting, the convolutional neural network can extract the abstract features of the image. For these reasons, we proposed a new algorithm that combines the bag of word model and the convolutional neural network. The feature maps, extracted by the VGG16 neural network which is trained on the dataset named Places365 (VGG16-Places365), are used as the semantic descriptors instead of ORB descriptors. The workflow of building the vocabulary of the semantic words, extracting the feature vector of the image and computing the similarity score is presented. The performance of BOSW is evaluated by a comparison study with the traditional visual bag of word model and Inception-based deep learning method which use Inception's fully connected layer output as the feature vector of the picture. Overall, the experiments on New College datasets verified that our mode show stronger generalization and can achieve higher accuracy in the loop closure detection.

articleTitle: Method for Optimising Mission-Specific Inventory of Aviation Materials
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The acquisition and inventory planning of aviation materials have traditionally been based on consumption records. However, with increasingly volatile consumption, these methods can no longer ensure precise logistic support for aviation materials and the rapid deployment of military equipment for operational readiness. In this study, a system-optimisation-based method is proposed to inventory aviation materials. The model is verified by performing a simulated aircraft aviation mission. The results show that the proposed method can predict the required inventory of aviation materials and develop a logistic support plan for specified operating conditions. This study is extremely important for providing accurate logistic support of aviation materials.

articleTitle: Research on the Application and Development of Intelligent Inspection System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of internet and artificial intelligence, Internet+ and intelligence become the leading development direction of inspection. As the value chain extension and the driving force to reform the testing industry, the intelligent inspection system plays a more and more important role. This paper analyzes the research and application of intelligent inspection systems and studies the relevant macro-environment from four aspects based on the PEST method. Then, combined with the analysis of the upstream and downstream industries, the development prospect of the intelligent inspection system is discussed.

articleTitle: Detection of natural gas H2O content based on Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents an exploratory study on the detection of natural gas water content by Raman spectroscopy. The method uses long range optical cell to enhance gas Raman signal and builds Raman gas detection platform, by which achieves the Raman spectrogram of water vapor in natural gas under normal temperature and pressure. Besides, the paper also discussed the influence of pressure on Raman spectrum analysis of water. The experimental results show that there is a linear relationship between the spectral peak area and the water vapor concentration, which provides a new scheme for the detection of natural gas water content.

articleTitle: Important Nodes Identification based on Degree and Structural Entropy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology,Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Identification of important node is one of the main tasks of for complex network analysis, which is of great significance to the study of network structure. The classical method for important node identification only considers one influencing factor related to the network topology structure, and the evaluation result unable to reflect the real structure of the network comprehensively. In order to mine the important nodes in the network accurately, based on the uncertainty of network structure information and the closeness between the nodes, by combining the topological structure information between nodes and quantifying the influence between nodes, an important node identification method is proposed which takes into account the weight factor of nodes and the entropy of local network structure. By using the SIR propagation model, the proposed method is tested on the simulated network and the real data set respectively. The results show the proposed method can effectively identify important nodes in the network.
